phrases.english: Could you read this email draft and tell me whether it sounds urgent or not?
phrases.chinese: 你方便帮我看看这封邮件草稿，说说语气听起来紧不紧急吗？

phrases.english: Could you read this flowchart and tell me where the bottleneck might be?
phrases.chinese: 你方便帮我看看这个流程图，说说瓶颈可能在哪儿吗？

phrases.english: Could you read this feedback summary and tell me which point needs clarification?
phrases.chinese: 你方便帮我看看这份反馈汇总，说说哪一点需要进一步说明吗？

phrases.english: Need a hand with anything?
phrases.chinese: 需要帮忙吗？

phrases.english: You’re balancing the ladder and holding paint — I’ll hold the base.
phrases.chinese: 你一边扶梯子一边端着油漆——我来帮你稳住梯脚。

phrases.english: You’ve got both hands full of library books — let me carry the top three.
phrases.chinese: 你两手全是图书馆借的书——我来帮你拿最上面三本。

phrases.english: You’re trying to open the gate, hold your toddler, and keep the dog from bolting — I’ll take the leash.
phrases.chinese: 你想开门、抱孩子、又怕狗跑掉——我来牵狗绳。

phrases.english: Where are you stuck?
phrases.chinese: 卡在哪儿了？

phrases.english: Is it the printer not connecting, or the document refusing to print?
phrases.chinese: 是打印机连不上，还是文档根本打不出来？

phrases.english: Would you like me to show you how to resize the image before saving?
phrases.chinese: 要我教你保存前怎么调整图片大小吗？

phrases.english: Should I check if the Wi-Fi’s on before you try loading the page?
phrases.chinese: 你打开网页前，要我先确认下Wi-Fi开着吗？

phrases.english: I’m free for a bit — what can I jump in on?
phrases.chinese: 我手头刚好有点空——哪件事我能马上搭把手？

phrases.english: You’re unloading groceries while holding your phone — I’ll put the bags away.
phrases.chinese: 你一手拎菜一手拿手机——我来把袋子收进厨房。

phrases.english: Your laptop battery’s at 12% — want me to plug it in while you finish that email?
phrases.chinese: 你笔记本只剩12%电了——要我帮你插上充电器，你先把这封邮件发完？

phrases.english: The oven timer just went off — I’ll pull out the cookies and set the cooling rack.
phrases.chinese: 烤箱定时响了——我来把饼干拿出来，再摆好晾架。

phrases.english: What’s the fastest thing I can do right now?
phrases.chinese: 我现在能最快帮上什么？

phrases.english: Is it the missing attachment, or the wrong recipient in the CC field?
phrases.chinese: 是漏了附件，还是抄送栏填错了人？

phrases.english: Would you like me to resend the invoice with the updated total?
phrases.chinese: 你想让我用更新后的金额重新发一遍发票吗？

phrases.english: Is it the blurry photo in the slide, or the typo on the title page?
phrases.chinese: 是幻灯片里照片太糊，还是标题页有错字？

phrases.english: I’m making tea — can I make you a cup too?
phrases.chinese: 我在泡茶——给你也泡一杯？

phrases.english: I’m walking the dog — want me to drop off your mail at the post office?
phrases.chinese: 我正遛狗——顺路帮你把信送到邮局？

phrases.english: I’m vacuuming the living room — happy to do your hallway while I’m at it.
phrases.chinese: 我在吸客厅地毯——顺手把你的走廊也吸了？

phrases.english: I’m updating the shared calendar — I’ll add your meeting as I go.
phrases.chinese: 我在更新共享日历——边改边把你那场会加进去。

phrases.english: Would you rather I handle the emails while you prep for the call?
phrases.chinese: 你希望我回邮件，好让你专心准备电话会议？

phrases.english: Could I draft the follow-up note while you wrap up the demo?
phrases.chinese: 你收尾演示时，我来写跟进备忘录，可以吗？

phrases.english: Would you like me to order lunch instead of asking everyone to choose?
phrases.chinese: 你希望我直接订好午餐，而不是让大家各自点单？

phrases.english: Do you want me to test the login flow while you update the error messages?
phrases.chinese: 你改错误提示时，要我同步测试登录流程吗？

phrases.english: Still okay if I take this over?
phrases.chinese: 我接手这事，还行吗？

phrases.english: Want me to pick up your dry cleaning on my way to work?
phrases.chinese: 我上班路上顺道帮你取干洗衣服？

phrases.english: Shall I resubmit the form with your corrected phone number?
phrases.chinese: 我把表格用你更正后的手机号重新提交，可以吗？

phrases.english: I can call the supplier about the delay — just say yes.
phrases.chinese: 我来打电话问供应商交货延迟的事——你点个头就行。

phrases.english: It’s fine — I’ll sort it out right away.
phrases.chinese: 没事——我马上处理好。

phrases.english: The trash bag ripped — I’ll grab a new one and re-bag everything.
phrases.chinese: 垃圾袋破了——我拿个新的，重新打包。

phrases.english: The remote’s not responding — I’ll replace the batteries and reset it.
phrases.chinese: 遥控器没反应——我来换电池，再重置一下。

phrases.english: The faucet’s dripping — I’ll tighten the handle and check the washer.
phrases.chinese: 水龙头在滴水——我来拧紧把手，并检查垫圈。

phrases.english: I’m free tomorrow morning — what should I tackle first?
phrases.chinese: 明天上午我有空——先从哪件开始？

phrases.english: I can cover your shift Friday afternoon — just tell me the details.
phrases.chinese: 周五下午我可以替你值班——你把细节告诉我就行。

phrases.english: I’ll proofread the proposal by Thursday noon — no edits without your green light.
phrases.chinese: 提案我周四中午前校对完——没你点头，一个字不改。

phrases.english: I’d be glad to help run the parent meeting — we can split the agenda and handouts.
phrases.chinese: 我很乐意一起组织家长会——议程和材料我们分工来。

phrases.english: I’ll draft it — just let me know if you want it simpler or more thorough.
phrases.chinese: 我来起草——你告诉我想要更简明些，还是更详尽些。

phrases.english: On it — I’ll share the key points by 10 a.m. and wait for your go-ahead.
phrases.chinese: 马上办——上午十点前发你要点，等你确认再继续。

phrases.english: Got it — I’ll send the summary and timeline by lunch, then pause for your input.
phrases.chinese: 明白——午饭前发你摘要和时间线，等你意见再推进。

phrases.english: All set — I’ll keep the file editable so we can revise together.
phrases.chinese: 妥了——文件我设为可编辑，咱们一起修改。

phrases.english: You just made my day — thank you so much!
phrases.chinese: 你让我今天特别开心——真的太感谢了！

phrases.english: You calmed me down before the big meeting — thank you so much!
phrases.chinese: 大会议前你几句话就让我稳住了——真的太感谢了！

phrases.english: You checked in on me after my bad news — thank you so much!
phrases.chinese: 我收到坏消息后，你主动来关心我——真的太感谢了！

phrases.english: You brought coffee when I was running on empty — thank you so much!
phrases.chinese: 我快累垮时，你给我带了杯咖啡——真的太感谢了！

phrases.english: You picked up my dry cleaning on your way home? That’s so kind.
phrases.chinese: 你回家顺路帮我取了干洗衣服？太暖心了。

phrases.english: You shared your notes from yesterday’s workshop? That’s so kind.
phrases.chinese: 你把昨天工作坊的笔记分享给我了？太暖心了。

phrases.english: You covered my shift when I had a family emergency? That’s so kind.
phrases.chinese: 我家里突发急事，你主动替我值班？太暖心了。

phrases.english: You held the door open while I juggled three bags? That’s so kind.
phrases.chinese: 我一手拎三袋东西时，你一直扶着门等我？太暖心了。

phrases.english: So glad it helped — really happy to support you!
phrases.chinese: 很高兴帮上忙——能支持你，我打心底开心！

phrases.english: So glad it worked — truly happy to help out!
phrases.chinese: 事情成了——能搭把手，我由衷高兴！

phrases.english: So glad you got it sorted — absolutely delighted to pitch in!
phrases.chinese: 你顺利搞定了——能帮上忙，我特别欣慰！

phrases.english: So glad it landed safely — thrilled to have been useful!
phrases.chinese: 东西平安收到了——能派上用场，我特别开心！

phrases.english: Happy to help — seriously, no trouble at all!
phrases.chinese: 乐意帮忙——真的，一点不麻烦！

phrases.english: Happy to help — it was already on my list!
phrases.chinese: 乐意帮忙——这本来就在我的待办里！

phrases.english: Happy to help — I was doing it anyway!
phrases.chinese: 乐意帮忙——我本来就要做这事！

phrases.english: Happy to help — took less than a minute!
phrases.chinese: 乐意帮忙——不到一分钟就搞定！

phrases.english: I’m really glad it gave you some breathing room.
phrases.chinese: 只要你能松一口气，我就特别欣慰。

phrases.english: I’m really glad it freed up your afternoon.
phrases.chinese: 只要你下午能空出来，我就特别欣慰。

phrases.english: I’m really glad it kept you from missing dinner with your kids.
phrases.chinese: 只要你没错过陪孩子吃晚饭，我就特别欣慰。

phrases.english: I’m really glad it stopped you from having to cancel plans.
phrases.chinese: 只要你不用临时取消安排，我就特别欣慰。

phrases.english: Thanks for trusting me with this — I’ll give it my full attention.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你把这事交给我——我一定全力以赴。

phrases.english: Thanks for letting me handle the follow-up call — I’ll keep it brief and clear.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你让我负责后续电话——我会说得简洁清楚。

phrases.english: Thanks for asking me to draft the reply — I’ll make sure it’s friendly and on point.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你让我起草回复——我会确保语气友好、重点到位。

phrases.english: Thanks for assigning me to sort the files — I’ll label and file them by end of day.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你让我整理文件——我下班前就标好、归档好。

phrases.english: Let me take you out for coffee — you went way beyond what anyone expected!
phrases.chinese: 我请你喝杯咖啡吧——你做的远超所有人预期！

phrases.english: Let me treat you to lunch — you fixed the whole thing before the deadline!
phrases.chinese: 我请你吃顿午饭吧——你在截止前就把整件事搞定了！

phrases.english: Let me buy you a snack — you stepped in and saved the meeting!
phrases.chinese: 我给你买份小食吧——你及时补位，救了整场会！

phrases.english: Let me grab you a drink — you handled everything while I was away!
phrases.chinese: 我请你喝一杯吧——我不在时，你全权扛下了所有事！

phrases.english: Thanks for catching that typo — I’ll fix it before the final send.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你发现这个错字——我终稿发出前就改好。

phrases.english: Thanks for spotting the wrong name in the intro — I’ll correct it before printing.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你发现开场介绍里名字写错了——我打印前就改好。

phrases.english: Thanks for noticing the missing page number — I’ll add it before sharing.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你发现页码漏了——我分享前就补上。

phrases.english: Thanks for flagging the outdated link — I’ll replace it before posting.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你指出链接已失效——我发布前就换掉。

phrases.english: Thanks — I actually wrapped it up last night!
phrases.chinese: 谢谢——我其实昨晚就搞定了！

phrases.english: Thanks so much — I finished it during my lunch break!
phrases.chinese: 太感谢你了——我午饭时间就做完了！

phrases.english: That’s so thoughtful — I booked the tickets myself this morning!
phrases.chinese: 你真是太周到了——我今早自己就把票订好了！

phrases.english: Appreciate you offering — I sorted it out over the weekend!
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你主动提出——我周末就处理好了！

phrases.english: Got it — thanks again, and hope you have a relaxing evening!
phrases.chinese: 收到啦——再次感谢，祝你今晚轻松惬意！

phrases.english: All set — thanks a million, and hope you get some rest tonight!
phrases.chinese: 全部搞定啦——万分感谢，祝你今晚好好休息！

phrases.english: Done — truly grateful, and hope you have a peaceful morning tomorrow!
phrases.chinese: 搞定啦——真心感激，祝你明天早晨宁静从容！

phrases.english: Perfect — huge thanks, and hope you enjoy a slow, easy day!
phrases.chinese: 完美——特别感谢，愿你今天节奏舒缓、自在轻松！

phrases.english: Sorry I sent the wrong file — it was the draft, not the final version.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉发错了文件，发的是草稿，不是最终版。

phrases.english: Sorry I copied the wrong address — I used last year’s invoice instead of the updated one.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉抄错了地址，我用了去年的发票，不是更新后的那份。

phrases.english: Sorry I quoted the old price — I didn’t notice the discount had expired yesterday.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉报了旧价格，我没注意到折扣昨天就到期了。

phrases.english: I’m sorry I’m running late — my train got held at the station.
phrases.chinese: 很抱歉我要迟到了，我的火车在车站临时停靠了。

phrases.english: I’m sorry I won’t finish the report by Friday — my laptop crashed and I lost half a day’s work.
phrases.chinese: 很抱歉我周五前完不成报告，笔记本电脑突然崩溃，我丢了一半的工作时间。

phrases.english: I’m sorry I missed our 3 p.m. call — I double-booked and only just saw the conflict.
phrases.chinese: 很抱歉我错过了我们下午三点的通话，我日程重复安排了，刚刚才看到冲突。

phrases.english: I thought ‘review by Friday’ meant I could send it Friday morning — turns out you needed it Thursday night.
phrases.chinese: 我以为‘周五前审核’是指周五上午交，原来你周四晚上就要。

phrases.english: I assumed ‘final sign-off’ meant your quick glance — I didn’t realize you’d need to consult the whole team first.
phrases.chinese: 我原以为‘最终签字确认’只是请你快速过一眼，没想到你还得先和整个团队商量。

phrases.english: I took ‘send to all’ as including interns — I didn’t know they weren’t cleared for that info.
phrases.chinese: 我理解‘发送给所有人’包括实习生，不知道他们还没获得该信息的查阅权限。

phrases.english: I’m sorry for the trouble — I’ll resend the correct link right now.
phrases.chinese: 为带来的麻烦向你道歉，我这就重新发送正确链接。

phrases.english: I’m sorry for the mix-up — I’ll rebook your appointment and call you with the new time in five minutes.
phrases.chinese: 为造成的混乱向你道歉，我会重新预约你的时段，并五分钟内打电话告诉你新时间。

phrases.english: I’m sorry for the hassle — I’ll print and drop off the signed forms at your desk before noon.
phrases.chinese: 为带来的不便向你道歉，我会打印好已签字的表格，中午前送到你桌上。

phrases.english: Sorry for cutting in — go ahead, I’m listening.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉插话了，请继续，我在听。

phrases.english: Sorry for jumping in — I’ll wait while you finish what you were saying.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉打断了，我等你把刚才的话说完。

phrases.english: Sorry for interrupting — please keep going, I won’t speak again until you’re done.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉打断你了，请继续说，你没讲完之前我不会再开口。

phrases.english: I forgot to confirm the meeting — I’ll check your calendar and lock it in now.
phrases.chinese: 我忘了确认会议，我这就查你的日历，马上定下来。

phrases.english: I forgot to forward the client’s note — I’ll send it to you and the manager right this second.
phrases.chinese: 我忘了转发客户的留言，我这就发给你和主管。

phrases.english: I forgot to update the shared doc — I’ll add the changes and highlight them before lunch.
phrases.chinese: 我忘了更新共享文档，我午饭前就把修改内容加上并标出来。

phrases.english: That sounded harsh — I didn’t mean to sound impatient, just rushed.
phrases.chinese: 那听起来有点生硬，我不是有意显得不耐烦，只是当时赶时间。

phrases.english: My message came across as cold — I was typing fast and didn’t pause to soften it.
phrases.chinese: 我的消息显得冷淡，我打字太快，没停下来润色语气。

phrases.english: That reply felt dismissive — I was trying to move things along, but I see why it landed wrong.
phrases.chinese: 那个回复显得敷衍，我想推进事情进展，但明白为什么让你感觉被轻视了。

phrases.english: I’m sorry — I’ll correct it and send the fix by 11 a.m.
phrases.chinese: 我道歉，我会修正并上午十一点前发给你更正版。

phrases.english: I’m sorry — I’ll resend the order confirmation and include tracking by 10 a.m.
phrases.chinese: 我道歉，我会重发订单确认函，并在上午十点前附上物流单号。

phrases.english: I’m sorry — I’ll reschedule both appointments and text you the new times in ten minutes.
phrases.chinese: 我道歉，我会重新安排两次预约，并十分钟内短信告诉你新时间。

phrases.english: I can’t make the call tomorrow — but I’ll send full notes and action items tonight.
phrases.chinese: 明天的通话我没法参加了，但我今晚会把完整纪要和待办事项发给你。

phrases.english: I can’t join the workshop — but I’ll share my slides and speaker script by end of day.
phrases.chinese: 我没法参加工作坊，但我下班前会把幻灯片和发言稿发给你。

phrases.english: I can’t cover your shift Saturday — but I’ll take the Sunday shift and handle the handover Friday afternoon.
phrases.chinese: 周六的班我没法替你值，但我周日顶上，并周五下午做好交接。

phrases.english: I know this delays your next step — I’ll give you a clear update every morning until it’s done.
phrases.chinese: 我知道这耽误了你的下一步，我会每天早上给你明确进展，直到完成。

phrases.english: I see this throws off your schedule — I’ll adjust my part and send you the revised plan by 4 p.m.
phrases.chinese: 我明白这打乱了你的计划，我会调整我的部分，下午四点前把修订方案发给你。

phrases.english: I realize this affects your deadline — I’ll do my part tonight and get it to you before midnight.
phrases.chinese: 我意识到这影响了你的截止时间，我今晚就做完，午夜前发给你。

phrases.english: Free for coffee this Saturday?
phrases.chinese: 这周六有空一起喝杯咖啡吗？

phrases.english: Up for a walk in Riverside Park Sunday morning?
phrases.chinese: 周日上午去河滨公园散散步？

phrases.english: Feel like catching that documentary at the downtown cinema tonight?
phrases.chinese: 今晚想去市中心影院看那部纪录片吗？

phrases.english: Would you like to join us for dinner at our place this Sunday?
phrases.chinese: 这周日来我们家吃晚饭好吗？

phrases.english: Would you be available for tea at Willow & Thyme this Friday?
phrases.chinese: 这周五有空来柳与百里香茶馆喝杯茶吗？

phrases.english: Would you be open to joining the rooftop gathering this afternoon?
phrases.chinese: 今天下午来天台小聚，你方便参加吗？

phrases.english: I’m wide open next week—just say what suits you.
phrases.chinese: 下周我时间完全空着，你哪天合适直接说。

phrases.english: My calendar’s clear—I’ll match your timing.
phrases.chinese: 我日程全空着，完全按你的时间来。

phrases.english: No fixed plans—I’ll wait for your signal.
phrases.chinese: 我还没定安排，等你消息再敲定。

phrases.english: How about trying the dumpling stall by the old train station?
phrases.chinese: 老火车站旁那家饺子摊，要不要去试试？

phrases.english: What if we head to the community garden instead? They just opened the new greenhouse.
phrases.chinese: 要是去社区花园呢？他们刚开放了新温室。

phrases.english: Should we meet at the library courtyard before the poetry reading?
phrases.chinese: 诗歌朗诵开始前，咱们在图书馆庭院碰头？

phrases.english: Let’s meet for coffee at The Daily Grind—right across from City Hall.
phrases.chinese: 就在市政厅斜对面的每日研磨咖啡馆见吧。

phrases.english: Can we hold the neighborhood cleanup this Saturday? Same route, different start time.
phrases.chinese: 社区清洁活动能改到这周六吗？路线不变，只是出发时间调整。

phrases.english: How about moving the pottery workshop to the craft studio on Elm Street?
phrases.chinese: 陶艺工作坊挪到榆树街手作工作室，怎么样？

phrases.english: Are you free Saturday or Sunday? I can do either.
phrases.chinese: 周六或周日你哪天有空？我哪天都行。

phrases.english: Does Tuesday or Wednesday evening work better for you? I’ll keep it open.
phrases.chinese: 周二或周三晚上对你更合适？我随时配合。

phrases.english: Is 11 a.m. or 2 p.m. easier tomorrow? I’ll block whichever you choose.
phrases.chinese: 明日上午十一点还是下午两点对你更方便？你选哪个，我就留哪个时间段。

phrases.english: Let’s meet outside the blue door of the old post office—it’s hard to miss.
phrases.chinese: 我们在老邮局那扇蓝色大门外见吧，特别好找。

phrases.english: We’ve set up the picnic blankets near the willow tree—see you there at noon?
phrases.chinese: 野餐垫已经铺在那棵柳树下了——中午那儿见？

phrases.english: The entrance with the red bench is closest to the bus stop—let’s gather there at 5:30.
phrases.chinese: 带红长椅的那个入口离公交站最近，五点半那儿集合？

phrases.english: My brother’s flying in from Seattle Friday—he’ll join our barbecue.
phrases.chinese: 我哥哥周五从西雅图飞过来，也一起来参加我们的烧烤。

phrases.english: My colleague from the design team is visiting next month—can she tag along on the museum tour?
phrases.chinese: 设计组的同事下个月来参观，她能跟我们一起逛博物馆吗？

phrases.english: My friend’s toddler just started walking—she’d love to bring him to the playground meetup.
phrases.chinese: 我朋友家的小宝宝刚学会走路，她想带他来游乐场聚会。

phrases.english: That sounds lovely—what time does it usually get going?
phrases.chinese: 听上去真不错——一般大概几点开始？

phrases.english: I’d really enjoy that—will it be indoors or outdoors? Just curious.
phrases.chinese: 我很乐意参加——是在室内还是室外？单纯想了解一下。

phrases.english: Count me in—do you need help bringing anything? Happy to contribute.
phrases.chinese: 算我一个——需要我带点什么吗？很乐意帮忙。

phrases.english: No worries at all—only if it truly fits your schedule.
phrases.chinese: 完全没关系——只要你时间真的合适，再参加。

phrases.english: Absolutely no obligation—just thought I’d float the idea.
phrases.chinese: 一点没义务——就是顺手提个想法。

phrases.english: Zero pressure—happy either way, and no explanation needed.
phrases.chinese: 毫无压力——你怎么决定我都开心，也完全不用解释。

phrases.english: Are you free this Saturday afternoon?
phrases.chinese: 这周六下午你有空吗？

phrases.english: Are you free for coffee tomorrow at two?
phrases.chinese: 明天两点一起喝杯咖啡，你有空吗？

phrases.english: How’s Sunday morning for a walk in the park?
phrases.chinese: 周日早上一起去公园散步，你觉得怎么样？

phrases.english: Let’s go for a bike ride along the river.
phrases.chinese: 咱们沿着河骑自行车吧。

phrases.english: Let’s try that new bakery on Main Street.
phrases.chinese: 咱们去主街那家新开的面包店吧。

phrases.english: Let’s watch the sunset from the hilltop trail.
phrases.chinese: 咱们去山顶步道看日落吧。

phrases.english: Is next Thursday at six still good for you?
phrases.chinese: 下周四六点对你来说还合适吗？

phrases.english: Is Wednesday evening still okay for you?
phrases.chinese: 周三晚上你时间还方便吗？

phrases.english: Are you still free Sunday at eleven?
phrases.chinese: 周日十一点你还有空吗？

phrases.english: Shall we meet at the library entrance at four?
phrases.chinese: 咱们四点在图书馆门口见，可以吗？

phrases.english: Shall we meet outside the post office at 3:30?
phrases.chinese: 咱们三点三十分在邮局外面见，可以吗？

phrases.english: Shall we meet at the bus stop near the market at five?
phrases.chinese: 咱们五点在市场附近的公交站见，可以吗？

phrases.english: The café on Elm Street is quieter—shall we go there?
phrases.chinese: 榆树街那家咖啡馆更安静，咱们去那儿吧？

phrases.english: The garden behind City Hall has more shade—shall we meet there?
phrases.chinese: 市政厅后面的花园阴凉更多，咱们去那儿见面吧？

phrases.english: The bookstore upstairs has comfy chairs—shall we sit there?
phrases.chinese: 楼上那家书店椅子很舒服，咱们去那儿坐吧？

phrases.english: Can we switch to the 4 p.m. slot instead?
phrases.chinese: 咱们能换成下午四点那个时间段吗？

phrases.english: Can we move it to 10 a.m. tomorrow?
phrases.chinese: 咱们能改到明天上午十点吗？

phrases.english: Can we do it at 7 p.m. on Friday?
phrases.chinese: 咱们能定在周五晚上七点吗？

phrases.english: We’re meeting at the corner café at three—see you then!
phrases.chinese: 我们在街角那家咖啡馆三点见——到时候见！

phrases.english: We’re meeting at the public garden fountain at noon—see you soon!
phrases.chinese: 我们中午在公共花园喷泉那儿见——待会见！

phrases.english: We’re meeting at the train station lobby at 2:45—see you there!
phrases.chinese: 我们两点半四十五分在火车站大厅见——不见不散！

phrases.english: I can’t make it tonight—let’s reschedule for Tuesday.
phrases.chinese: 今晚我来不了了——咱们改到周二吧。

phrases.english: I have to cancel tonight—I’ll be out of town until Wednesday.
phrases.chinese: 今晚得取消了——我要出城，周三才能回来。

phrases.english: I need to back out tonight—my car broke down on the highway.
phrases.chinese: 今晚我得退出了——我的车在高速公路上抛锚了。

phrases.english: I’ll handle the venue booking—can you take care of snacks?
phrases.chinese: 场地我来订，零食你负责可以吗？

phrases.english: I’ll bring the board games—can you bring drinks?
phrases.chinese: 我带桌游，饮料你带可以吗？

phrases.english: I’ll set up the projector—can you arrange chairs and tables?
phrases.chinese: 我来装投影仪，桌椅你来安排可以吗？

phrases.english: So—Saturday at four, the riverside park, and you’ll bring the blanket.
phrases.chinese: 那就定周六四点，在河滨公园，毯子你带。

phrases.english: So—Thursday at noon, the community center kitchen, and I’ll prep the ingredients.
phrases.chinese: 那就定周四中午，在社区中心厨房，食材我来准备。

phrases.english: So—Sunday at ten, the botanical garden entrance, and we’ll both bring water bottles.
phrases.chinese: 那就定周日上午十点，在植物园入口，咱们都带上水瓶。

phrases.english: Something came up — can we reschedule?
phrases.chinese: 临时有事——咱们能改个时间吗？

phrases.english: My train was canceled — can we meet later this week?
phrases.chinese: 我的火车停运了——咱们这周晚点再碰面可以吗？

phrases.english: I got called into work — can we push our coffee to Saturday?
phrases.chinese: 我被临时叫去上班了——咱们咖啡改到周六行吗？

phrases.english: I need to cancel — what’s your next open slot?
phrases.chinese: 我得取消这次安排——你下一个空闲时段是什么时候？

phrases.english: I’m running a fever — could we do it next Tuesday?
phrases.chinese: 我发烧了——咱们改下周二可以吗？

phrases.english: My car broke down — would Wednesday afternoon work?
phrases.chinese: 我的车抛锚了——周三下午对你合适吗？

phrases.english: Let’s move it to Friday at 2 p.m.
phrases.chinese: 咱们改到周五下午两点吧。

phrases.english: How about shifting the call to Monday at 9 a.m.?
phrases.chinese: 咱们把通话调到周一上午九点，怎么样？

phrases.english: Let’s reschedule the pickup to Thursday at 4 p.m.
phrases.chinese: 咱们把取件时间改到周四下午四点吧。

phrases.english: Are we still meeting at the bookstore at noon?
phrases.chinese: 咱们还按原计划中午在书店碰面吗？

phrases.english: Is the walk still on for 7 a.m. at Riverside Park?
phrases.chinese: 晨跑还按原计划早上七点在河滨公园吗？

phrases.english: Are we still doing the handoff at the post office by 5 p.m.?
phrases.chinese: 咱们还按原计划下午五点前在邮局交接吗？

phrases.english: Let’s keep it as planned — I’ve already set up everything.
phrases.chinese: 咱们就按原计划来吧——所有东西我都准备好了。

phrases.english: Let’s stick with the picnic in the backyard — the grill is ready.
phrases.chinese: 咱们野餐还就在后院吧——烤架已经备好了。

phrases.english: Let’s hold the call at 6 p.m. — my evening is clear.
phrases.chinese: 咱们通话就定在晚上六点吧——我晚上没别的安排。

phrases.english: Could we switch to texting instead of calling?
phrases.chinese: 咱们能把电话改成发短信吗？

phrases.english: Would it work to share notes over email instead of meeting?
phrases.chinese: 咱们用邮件共享笔记代替见面，可以吗？

phrases.english: Can we meet at the corner bench instead of the café?
phrases.chinese: 咱们在街角长椅碰面，别去咖啡馆了，可以吗？

phrases.english: Can we confirm the new time? I’ll add it now.
phrases.chinese: 咱们再确认下新时间吧？我这就加上日程。

phrases.english: Can we reconfirm the drop-off time with the courier before we leave?
phrases.chinese: 出发前咱们能跟快递员再确认下交货时间吗？

phrases.english: Should we double-check the start time with the instructor before class?
phrases.chinese: 上课前咱们得跟教练再确认下开始时间吧？

phrases.english: No problem — I’ll shift things around right away.
phrases.chinese: 没问题——我马上调整安排。

phrases.english: All good — I’ll make room for it now.
phrases.chinese: 一切OK——我这就腾出时间来。

phrases.english: Fine with me — just let me know when.
phrases.chinese: 我这边没问题——你定好时间告诉我就行。

phrases.english: I’m swamped this week — can we shorten our call to 10 minutes?
phrases.chinese: 这周我特别忙——咱们通话压缩到十分钟可以吗？

phrases.english: I’m packing for a trip — can we move our chat to tomorrow morning?
phrases.chinese: 我在收拾行李准备出行——咱们聊天能挪到明天早上吗？

phrases.english: I’m covering a shift — can we do a quick check-in after 8 p.m.?
phrases.chinese: 我要顶班——咱们能八点以后快速沟通一下吗？

phrases.english: So it’s confirmed: Tuesday at 3 p.m. outside the gym?
phrases.chinese: 那就确认了：周二下午三点，在健身房门口？

phrases.english: Just to confirm: we’re meeting at the bus stop at 6 a.m., right?
phrases.chinese: 再确认一次：我们是早上六点在公交站碰面，对吧？

phrases.english: Final check: the repair person comes Thursday at 11 a.m., correct?
phrases.chinese: 最后确认一下：维修师傅周四上午十一点来，对吧？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: It's 7:12 — the bus leaves in two minutes.
phrases.chinese: 现在是七点十二分，公交车两分钟后发车。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: It's 9:58 — the museum closes at ten.
phrases.chinese: 现在是九点五十八分，博物馆十点关门。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: It's 1:03 — the microwave just beeped.
phrases.chinese: 现在是一点零三分，微波炉刚响了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: What time is it?
phrases.chinese: 现在几点了？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Do you know the time? My phone died.
phrases.chinese: 你知道现在几点吗？我手机没电了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Sorry — what time is it? I can't see my watch in this light.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉——现在几点？这光线我看不清我的表。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: The meeting starts at 10:20.
phrases.chinese: 会议十点二十分开始。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: My train departs at 3:35 p.m.
phrases.chinese: 我的火车下午三点三十五分发车。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: We need to be at the gate by 6:18.
phrases.chinese: 我们必须六点十八分前到达登机口。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: When you say ‘this evening’, do you mean before or after 8?
phrases.chinese: 你说‘今晚’，是指八点之前还是之后？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: You said ‘late morning’ — does that mean 10:30 or 11:45?
phrases.chinese: 你说‘上午晚些时候’，是指十点半还是十一点四十五分？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: ‘Tomorrow afternoon’ — are we talking before lunch or after 2?
phrases.chinese: ‘明天下午’，我们说的是午饭前，还是两点之后？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: This load of laundry takes about thirty-five minutes.
phrases.chinese: 这一批衣服洗完晾好大约需要三十五分钟。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Walking to the post office takes twelve minutes.
phrases.chinese: 走到邮局要十二分钟。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Filling up the gas tank and paying takes under five minutes.
phrases.chinese: 加满油并付款不到五分钟。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Are you free Thursday between 3 and 5?
phrases.chinese: 你周四三点到五点之间有空吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Can you talk Tuesday morning? Anytime before noon works.
phrases.chinese: 你周二上午方便通话吗？中午前的任何时间都行。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Is 1:15 Friday open on your schedule?
phrases.chinese: 你周五一点十五分的日程有空吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: I walk the dog every evening at 6:00.
phrases.chinese: 我每天晚上六点遛狗。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: The trash gets collected every Friday at 7:30 a.m.
phrases.chinese: 垃圾每周五早上七点半清运。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: My coffee maker turns on automatically at 5:50.
phrases.chinese: 我的咖啡机每天自动在五点五十启动。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: The library closes at 9:00 — last call is at 8:45.
phrases.chinese: 图书馆九点关门，最后借阅提醒是八点四十五分。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: All forms must be submitted by end of day today.
phrases.chinese: 所有表格必须在今天下班前提交。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: The oven shuts off automatically at 8:00 — no later.
phrases.chinese: 烤箱八点自动关闭，不能更晚。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: If it's 2 p.m. in Tokyo, it's 5 a.m. in London — nine hours behind.
phrases.chinese: 如果东京是下午两点，伦敦就是凌晨五点，相差九个小时。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: You're in Sydney — when it's 7 a.m. there, what time is it in Toronto?
phrases.chinese: 你在悉尼，那儿早上七点时，多伦多是几点？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Our 4 p.m. call in Los Angeles means 7 a.m. in Singapore — okay for you?
phrases.chinese: 我们在洛杉矶下午四点的通话，对应新加坡早上七点，对你方便吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Let's check in every Friday at 9:15.
phrases.chinese: 咱们每周五九点十五分同步一下。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: Can we do weekly stand-ups every Tuesday at 10:10?
phrases.chinese: 咱们能把每周站会定在每周二十点十分吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in time and schedules
phrases.english: How about monthly team lunches on the first Thursday at 12:30?
phrases.chinese: 每月团队午餐定在每月第一个周四十二点半，怎么样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Can you take out the trash before lunch?
phrases.chinese: 你午饭前能倒一下垃圾吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Could you wipe down the stove after breakfast?
phrases.chinese: 早饭后你能把灶台擦一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Will you vacuum the hallway before your meeting?
phrases.chinese: 你开会前能把走廊吸一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I just changed the kitchen lightbulb.
phrases.chinese: 我刚把厨房的灯泡换好了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I refilled the soap dispenser in the guest bathroom.
phrases.chinese: 我把客用洗手间的洗手液补满了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I cleaned the microwave and wiped the stovetop.
phrases.chinese: 我把微波炉清理了，灶台也擦干净了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I’ll mop the floor if you scrub the sink.
phrases.chinese: 你刷水槽，我来拖地。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I’ll unload the dishwasher if you load it next time.
phrases.chinese: 你下次负责装洗碗机，这次我来卸。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I’ll sweep the porch if you hose down the patio.
phrases.chinese: 你冲一下露台，我来扫门廊。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: You said ‘empty the bins’ — do you mean all three, or just the ones in the kitchen?
phrases.chinese: 你说‘清空垃圾桶’，是指全部三个，还是只清厨房那两个？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: When you asked me to ‘organize the pantry’, did you want me to sort by category or by expiry date?
phrases.chinese: 你让我‘整理食品柜’，是按类别分，还是按保质期排？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: You said ‘feed the cat’ — should I give her the wet food too, or just the dry?
phrases.chinese: 你说‘喂猫’，是连湿粮一起给，还是只给干粮？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Let’s alternate who cleans the bathroom each week.
phrases.chinese: 咱们轮流每周打扫一次浴室吧。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: How about we switch who takes out the recycling every other Tuesday?
phrases.chinese: 咱们每两周换一次谁负责周二拿可回收垃圾出去，怎么样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Shall we rotate who walks the dog on weekday mornings?
phrases.chinese: 工作日早上遛狗的人，咱们轮流来，行吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Can you put the laundry in the dryer before you leave for work?
phrases.chinese: 你上班前能把衣服放进烘干机吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Could you start the dishwasher before you head to the gym?
phrases.chinese: 你去健身房前能把洗碗机启动一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Can you feed the cat and close the blinds before you go to the store?
phrases.chinese: 你去超市前能喂下猫、顺手拉上窗帘吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Want me to fold the laundry while you’re on that video call?
phrases.chinese: 你开视频会议的时候，我顺手把衣服叠了？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Should I water the balcony plants while you’re picking up the kids?
phrases.chinese: 你接孩子的时候，我顺便给阳台植物浇个水？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Can I clean the coffee maker while you’re making lunch?
phrases.chinese: 你做午饭的时候，我顺手把咖啡机清理一下？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: The toilet is running — who handles plumbing issues?
phrases.chinese: 马桶一直在流水，家里谁管管道问题？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: The front door lock is sticking — who checks hardware problems?
phrases.chinese: 大门锁有点卡，家里谁负责检查五金问题？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: The garage door won’t close fully — who deals with opener repairs?
phrases.chinese: 车库门关不严，家里谁负责修开门器？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I’ll cook dinner tonight, but I can’t also scrub the shower tiles.
phrases.chinese: 今晚我做饭，但实在没时间刷淋浴房瓷砖。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I’ll walk the dog this evening, but I can’t vacuum the living room afterward.
phrases.chinese: 今晚我遛狗，但之后没时间吸客厅了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: I’m happy to make breakfast, but I won’t have time to wipe down the counters and empty the bins.
phrases.chinese: 我乐意做早饭，但没时间擦台面和清空垃圾桶。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Thanks for cleaning the bathroom — I’ll tackle the kitchen now.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你把浴室打扫了，接下来我来弄厨房。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Thanks for taking out the trash — I’ll wipe down the dining table and chairs.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你倒了垃圾，我来擦餐桌和椅子。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in home and chores
phrases.english: Thanks for loading the dishwasher — I’ll dry and put away the clean dishes.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你把碗放进洗碗机了，我来擦干并收好。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: What’s for dinner tonight?
phrases.chinese: 今晚吃啥？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: What’s for lunch today?
phrases.chinese: 今天午饭吃啥？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: What should we have for breakfast tomorrow?
phrases.chinese: 明天早餐吃点啥？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: How do you like your eggs—scrambled, fried, or boiled?
phrases.chinese: 你鸡蛋喜欢怎么吃——炒的、煎的，还是水煮的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Do you take milk in your coffee?
phrases.chinese: 咖啡里要加奶吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Is this too spicy for you?
phrases.chinese: 这个对你来说太辣了吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I’ll cook dinner—I’ve got everything ready.
phrases.chinese: 我来做晚饭吧，食材都备好了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I’ll make soup—I’ve already chopped the vegetables.
phrases.chinese: 我来煮汤吧，蔬菜已经切好了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I’ll fry the chicken—I’ve seasoned it and heated the oil.
phrases.chinese: 我来炸鸡吧，已经腌好，油也烧热了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Should I add the salt now or wait?
phrases.chinese: 盐现在放，还是再等等？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Do I cover the pot while the rice cooks?
phrases.chinese: 煮米饭的时候锅要盖上盖子吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Do I rinse the lentils before boiling them?
phrases.chinese: 煮扁豆前要先冲洗一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I stir it constantly until it thickens.
phrases.chinese: 我一边煮一边搅，直到变浓稠。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I let the dough rest for thirty minutes before rolling it out.
phrases.chinese: 面团醒三十分钟再擀开。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I bake it at 375°F until the top is golden brown.
phrases.chinese: 375华氏度烤到表面金黄。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Can I use lemon juice instead of vinegar?
phrases.chinese: 醋能换成柠檬汁吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Would almond butter work instead of peanut butter here?
phrases.chinese: 这里花生酱能换成杏仁酱吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Can I swap white flour for whole wheat?
phrases.chinese: 普通面粉能换成全麦粉吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: This tastes really fresh and light.
phrases.chinese: 这个吃起来特别清爽轻盈。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: The crust is super crispy and the inside is soft.
phrases.chinese: 外皮特别酥脆，里面却很松软。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: It’s creamy but not heavy—just right.
phrases.chinese: 口感顺滑但不腻，刚刚好。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Does this need more salt?
phrases.chinese: 这个还要再加点盐吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Is the sauce too sweet for you?
phrases.chinese: 这酱汁对你来说太甜了吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Does the salad taste bright enough?
phrases.chinese: 这沙拉够爽口吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I don’t eat meat—I’ll skip the bacon.
phrases.chinese: 我不吃肉，培根我就不用了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I’m gluten-free—I’ll use tamari instead of soy sauce.
phrases.chinese: 我不能吃麸质，酱油就用塔马里酱代替。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: I’m cutting back on sugar—I’ll leave out the honey.
phrases.chinese: 我在控糖，蜂蜜就不加了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Let’s cook together—you chop, I’ll sauté!
phrases.chinese: 咱们一起做饭吧——你切菜，我来炒！

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Let’s make pizza—we’ll roll the dough and top it side by side.
phrases.chinese: 咱们做披萨吧——一起擀面饼、铺料！

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in food and cooking
phrases.english: Let’s cook curry—I’ll toast the spices, you stir the pot.
phrases.chinese: 咱们做咖喱吧——我来烤香料，你来搅锅！

phrases.english: Do you have a table for two right now?
phrases.chinese: 现在有两位的空桌吗？

phrases.english: We booked for two at seven — is our table ready?
phrases.chinese: 我们七点订了两位的位子，桌位准备好了吗？

phrases.english: Can we sit by the window? We’ve got a baby with us.
phrases.chinese: 我们可以坐靠窗的位置吗？我们带了宝宝。

phrases.english: What’s the most popular dish tonight?
phrases.chinese: 今晚哪道菜点得最多？

phrases.english: What’s your go-to starter when guests visit?
phrases.chinese: 客人来时，您最常推荐的前菜是哪一道？

phrases.english: Which curry is mild enough for kids?
phrases.chinese: 哪款咖喱辣度适合孩子吃？

phrases.english: We’ll start with these — we’ll let you know when we’re ready for more.
phrases.chinese: 我们先点这些，之后需要加菜再告诉您。

phrases.english: Just the appetizers for now — we’ll order mains after we’ve had a look.
phrases.chinese: 先点前菜，主菜等我们看过菜单再点。

phrases.english: We’ll share the pasta and split the burger — no sides needed.
phrases.chinese: 意面我们分着吃，汉堡也对半切开，不需要配菜。

phrases.english: Is this spicy, or just garnished with chili?
phrases.chinese: 这道菜是辣的，还是只放了辣椒装饰？

phrases.english: Does the ‘vegetarian’ option contain dairy or eggs?
phrases.chinese: ‘素食选项’里含奶制品或鸡蛋吗？

phrases.english: Is the soup made with chicken stock or vegetable broth?
phrases.chinese: 这碗汤是用鸡汤还是素高汤煮的？

phrases.english: How long’s the wait right now?
phrases.chinese: 现在大概要等多久？

phrases.english: Do you take walk-ins, or is it reservations only?
phrases.chinese: 你们接受直接上门用餐，还是只接待预订客人？

phrases.english: Is there a wait for two at the bar?
phrases.chinese: 吧台两位现在要等位吗？

phrases.english: Could we get separate checks?
phrases.chinese: 可以给我们分开结账吗？

phrases.english: Could we get the check — we need to head out early?
phrases.chinese: 麻烦结账，我们得早点走。

phrases.english: Can we add a tip directly to the card payment?
phrases.chinese: 小费可以直接加到刷卡金额里吗？

phrases.english: Can we split the bill evenly?
phrases.chinese: 我们可以平均分账吗？

phrases.english: Can one person pay for everything and get reimbursed later?
phrases.chinese: 能由一个人统一付款，其他人之后再转账还钱吗？

phrases.english: Do you support splitting by item — like if three people ordered different things?
phrases.chinese: 你们支持按菜品分账吗？比如三个人点了不同的菜。

phrases.english: Can we get this to go?
phrases.chinese: 这道菜可以打包带走吗？

phrases.english: Is takeout available for the full menu tonight?
phrases.chinese: 今晚整张菜单都支持外带吗？

phrases.english: Can you pack our leftovers in separate containers?
phrases.chinese: 能把我们的剩菜分装在不同盒子里吗？

phrases.english: I made a reservation for two under Lee — is it confirmed?
phrases.chinese: 我以李姓为两位订了位，确认成功了吗？

phrases.english: I’m running ten minutes late — can you hold our table?
phrases.chinese: 我要晚到十分钟，能帮我们保留座位吗？

phrases.english: We added a third person — is there still space for us?
phrases.chinese: 我们临时加了一位，还能安排下我们三人吗？

phrases.english: This was such a lovely meal — thank you!
phrases.chinese: 这一餐特别美好，谢谢您！

phrases.english: The service was thoughtful and relaxed — really appreciated it.
phrases.chinese: 服务既周到又不打扰，真的非常感谢。

phrases.english: Everything tasted fresh and well balanced — you’ve got a real gem here.
phrases.chinese: 每一道都食材新鲜、口味平衡，你们这儿真是宝藏餐厅。

phrases.english: Where are the paper towels?
phrases.chinese: 纸巾在哪儿？

phrases.english: Where’s the unscented hand soap?
phrases.chinese: 无香型洗手液在哪儿？

phrases.english: Where’s the whole-grain pasta?
phrases.chinese: 全麦意面在哪儿？

phrases.english: Do you have a travel size?
phrases.chinese: 有旅行装的吗？

phrases.english: Do you have this in 200ml?
phrases.chinese: 这个有200毫升装的吗？

phrases.english: Is this sold in a six-pack?
phrases.chinese: 这个是六支装的吗？

phrases.english: How much is this?
phrases.chinese: 这个多少钱？

phrases.english: Is there a discount for three or more?
phrases.chinese: 买三件或以上有优惠吗？

phrases.english: Do seniors get a discount on this?
phrases.chinese: 老年人买这个能享受折扣吗？

phrases.english: Do you have this in navy blue?
phrases.chinese: 这个有藏青色的吗？

phrases.english: Do you have this yoga mat extra-thick?
phrases.chinese: 这款瑜伽垫有加厚款的吗？

phrases.english: Do you have this scarf longer?
phrases.chinese: 这条围巾有加长款的吗？

phrases.english: Is this in stock today?
phrases.chinese: 这个今天有货吗？

phrases.english: Are the ceramic plant pots still in stock?
phrases.chinese: 陶瓷花盆还有货吗？

phrases.english: Is the black leather wallet in stock right now?
phrases.chinese: 黑色皮质钱包现在有货吗？

phrases.english: What’s a good moisturizer for dry skin?
phrases.chinese: 皮肤干燥，用什么保湿霜比较好？

phrases.english: Which broth has the least sodium?
phrases.chinese: 哪款高汤钠含量最低？

phrases.english: What’s a reliable cordless vacuum brand?
phrases.chinese: 无线吸尘器哪个牌子比较靠谱？

phrases.english: Can you wrap this as a gift?
phrases.chinese: 能帮我把这个当礼物包一下吗？

phrases.english: Can you wrap these two candles together?
phrases.chinese: 这两支蜡烛能一起包成一份礼物吗？

phrases.english: Do you wrap board games?
phrases.chinese: 桌游提供礼品包装吗？

phrases.english: Can I return this unused, in original packaging?
phrases.chinese: 没拆封、原包装完好，可以退货吗？

phrases.english: Can I exchange this for another color within a week?
phrases.chinese: 一周内能换成别的颜色吗？

phrases.english: Do you accept returns on opened beauty products?
phrases.chinese: 已拆封的美妆产品能退货吗？

phrases.english: Can you point me to the eco-friendly cleaning supplies?
phrases.chinese: 能告诉我环保清洁用品在哪儿吗？

phrases.english: Can someone help me pick an air filter?
phrases.chinese: 有人能帮我选个空气滤芯吗？

phrases.english: Do you have staff who help with gluten-free baking items?
phrases.chinese: 有员工能协助挑选无麸质烘焙原料吗？

phrases.english: I need one stainless thermos, two insulated lunch boxes, and compostable plates.
phrases.chinese: 我要一个不锈钢保温杯、两个隔热便当盒，还有一包可降解餐盘。

phrases.english: I need three bamboo toothbrushes, refillable floss, and reusable produce bags.
phrases.chinese: 我想要三支竹制牙刷、一个可替换牙线分装器，还有一套可重复使用的果蔬袋。

phrases.english: I need a medium canvas tote, four linen napkins, and a small cork board.
phrases.chinese: 我要一个中号帆布托特包、四块亚麻餐巾，还有一块小号软木公告板。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I'd like to return this sweater — it's way too big.
phrases.chinese: 我想退这件毛衣，尺码太大了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I need to return these shoes — they hurt my feet after five minutes.
phrases.chinese: 这双鞋得退，穿五分钟脚就疼。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I want to return this blender — it won't turn on at all.
phrases.chinese: 这个搅拌机要退，根本开不了机。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I was charged twice for the same order — can you fix that?
phrases.chinese: 同一笔订单扣了两次款，能处理一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: My account shows two $34.99 charges from last night — I only ordered once.
phrases.chinese: 我账户里昨晚有两笔34.99美元扣款，但我只下单了一次。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: The receipt says $29.99 but my card was charged $59.98 — what's the extra charge?
phrases.chinese: 小票写29.99美元，可我卡被刷了59.98美元，多出的那笔是什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Please put the refund back on the card I used.
phrases.chinese: 请把退款退回到我付款用的那张卡上。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Can you refund to the Amex I paid with — not the one I have on file?
phrases.chinese: 能退到我这次付款用的美国运通卡吗？别退到我资料里留的那张。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Refund to the debit card I checked out with — not store credit.
phrases.chinese: 请退到我结账用的借记卡，别给店内积分。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: How long does a direct bank refund usually take?
phrases.chinese: 银行直退一般要多久到账？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: If I choose store credit, does it show up right away?
phrases.chinese: 选店内积分的话，会立刻到账吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: How fast is PayPal for refunds — same day or next?
phrases.chinese: PayPal退款快吗？当天还是第二天到账？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Could you send a receipt for the return to my email?
phrases.chinese: 能发一封退货收据到我邮箱吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Can you print a receipt showing the refund amount and today’s date?
phrases.chinese: 能打一张收据吗？写明退款金额和今天日期。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I need a receipt with the return date for my records — is that possible?
phrases.chinese: 我得存档，能开一张带退货日期的收据吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I was charged $79.99 but only received one item — where’s the second?
phrases.chinese: 我被扣了79.99美元，但只收到一件，另一件在哪？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: There’s a $14.50 charge on my statement I don’t recognize — can you check it?
phrases.chinese: 我账单上有笔14.50美元扣款我不认识，能查一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I was charged for shipping even though the checkout said ‘free delivery’ — why?
phrases.chinese: 结账时明明写着‘免运费’，怎么还收了我运费？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Can I swap this for the same shirt in medium?
phrases.chinese: 这件能换成同款的中号衬衫吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Can I exchange this lamp for the smaller version with the dimmer switch?
phrases.chinese: 这个台灯能换成带调光开关的小号款吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Can I trade this backpack for the waterproof one in black?
phrases.chinese: 这个背包能换成黑色防水款吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I see the $42.99 refund posted to my account — thanks!
phrases.chinese: 我看到42.99美元退款已入账，谢谢！

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: The refund shows as ‘pending’ in my bank app — should I wait longer?
phrases.chinese: 银行App里这笔退款还显示‘待处理’，我需要再等吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: My account has the $42.99 credit but no order number attached.
phrases.chinese: 我账户里多了42.99美元，但没附任何订单号。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I dropped off the return Tuesday, but your site still says ‘not received’ — can you check?
phrases.chinese: 我周二就去寄了退货，你们网站还显示‘未收到’，能查一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: The drop-off confirmation says ‘received’ but my tracking hasn’t updated in three days.
phrases.chinese: 寄件确认单写‘已收件’，但物流三天没更新了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: Your system says the return shipped, but I never got a label — what happened?
phrases.chinese: 你们系统显示退货已发货，但我根本没收到退货单，怎么回事？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: I got $38.50 instead of $49.99 — what was deducted?
phrases.chinese: 我只收到38.50美元，不是应退的49.99美元，扣了什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: The refund is $38.50 but the original total was $49.99 — which part wasn’t refunded?
phrases.chinese: 退了38.50美元，原总价是49.99美元，哪部分没退？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in returns and payments
phrases.english: You sent $38.50 but my order summary says $49.99 — why the lower amount?
phrases.chinese: 你们退了38.50美元，但我订单明细写的是49.99美元，为什么少了？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: My throat is scratchy and it hurts to swallow.
phrases.chinese: 我喉咙发干发痒，吞咽时疼。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: My ear aches sharply every time I yawn.
phrases.chinese: 我每次打哈欠耳朵都一阵尖锐地疼。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: My ankle is swollen and warm, and it’s stiff when I walk.
phrases.chinese: 我脚踝又肿又烫，走路时僵硬。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: You’re shivering nonstop and your face looks pale.
phrases.chinese: 你一直在发抖，脸色煞白。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: You’re breathing so fast I can hear it from across the room.
phrases.chinese: 你呼吸太快了，我在房间对面都能听见。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Your hands are icy cold and trembling — are you dizzy?
phrases.chinese: 你双手冰凉发抖——头晕吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: This headache started yesterday morning and hasn’t eased up.
phrases.chinese: 这头痛从昨天早上开始，一直没缓解。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: My wrist has been sore and stiff for three days straight.
phrases.chinese: 我手腕连续三天又疼又僵。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: That cough began two nights ago and gets worse at night.
phrases.chinese: 这咳嗽两天前夜里开始，一到晚上就加重。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Does drinking warm water help your stomach pain?
phrases.chinese: 喝温水能缓解你的胃痛吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Did the rash spread after you wore that wool sweater?
phrases.chinese: 穿那件羊毛衫后，疹子是不是扩散了？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Does the dizziness go away if you sit still for a minute?
phrases.chinese: 你静坐一分钟，头晕会消失吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: I held my niece while she had a fever last weekend.
phrases.chinese: 上周末我抱过发高烧的侄女。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: My coworker vomited in the break room yesterday — I was there right after.
phrases.chinese: 我同事昨天在茶水间吐了——我紧跟着就进去了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: My mom’s been coughing nonstop for five days — we live together.
phrases.chinese: 我妈已经连续五天不停咳嗽——我们住在一起。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: I took ibuprofen thirty minutes ago — it’s starting to help.
phrases.chinese: 我三十分钟前吃了布洛芬——已经开始起效了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: I used a cold compress on my eye ten minutes ago — the swelling’s gone down.
phrases.chinese: 我十分钟前用冷敷袋敷了眼睛——肿消了一些。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: I gargled salt water just now — my throat feels less raw.
phrases.chinese: 我刚用盐水漱了口——嗓子不那么灼烧了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Can I leave work early? My fever spiked an hour ago.
phrases.chinese: 我能早点下班吗？我一小时前突然发高烧。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Can I take tomorrow off? My migraine hit hard this morning.
phrases.chinese: 我明天能请假吗？今早偏头痛突然发作得很厉害。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Can I work from home today? My nose is running and I’m sneezing constantly.
phrases.chinese: 我今天能居家办公吗？我流鼻涕、不停地打喷嚏。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: The diarrhea slowed down this afternoon — I only went twice.
phrases.chinese: 腹泻下午缓下来了——我整个下午只上了两次厕所。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: I climbed two flights of stairs without stopping — no chest tightness.
phrases.chinese: 我一口气爬了两层楼——没觉得胸闷。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: My fever broke last night — I slept through the whole night.
phrases.chinese: 我昨晚退烧了——整晚睡得很沉。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Could my roommate catch this? We share the same bathroom.
phrases.chinese: 我室友会被传染吗？我们共用一个卫生间。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Could my elderly dad get sick from me? He lives with us.
phrases.chinese: 我年迈的父亲会被我传染吗？他和我们住一起。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: Should I keep my toddler away from my sister? She’s pregnant.
phrases.chinese: 我该让一岁多的孩子避开我妹妹吗？她怀孕了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: The doctor told me to rest completely for three days and drink lots of water.
phrases.chinese: 医生让我彻底休息三天，并大量喝水。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: The nurse said to take acetaminophen every six hours if the pain returns.
phrases.chinese: 护士说如果疼痛复发，每六小时吃一次对乙酰氨基酚。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in health and feeling unwell
phrases.english: The GP advised me to avoid dairy until the stomach upset clears up.
phrases.chinese: 全科医生建议我等肠胃不适好转前先别吃奶制品。

phrases.english: It's pouring — I got soaked walking to the bus stop.
phrases.chinese: 大雨倾盆——我走到公交站就湿透了。

phrases.english: That gust just ripped my umbrella inside out — it’s useless now.
phrases.chinese: 刚才那阵风直接把我的伞吹翻了——这伞彻底报废了。

phrases.english: My shoes are squelching with every step — this puddle’s deeper than it looks.
phrases.chinese: 每走一步鞋里都咕叽响——这水坑比看着深多了。

phrases.english: Will it rain this afternoon? We’re meeting friends at the park.
phrases.chinese: 今天下午会下雨吗？我们约了朋友在公园见面。

phrases.english: Will it stay dry for the farmers’ market? My tote’s full of cash and no rain cover.
phrases.chinese: 农夫市集期间会一直不下雨吗？我帆布包里全是现金，可没带防雨罩。

phrases.english: Will the fog lift before our bike ride? The trail’s narrow and visibility’s near zero.
phrases.chinese: 大雾会在我们骑车前散开吗？小路很窄，现在几乎看不见。

phrases.english: It’s freezing — my breath is visible and my ears sting.
phrases.chinese: 冷得要命——我呼出的气都看得见，耳朵直发刺。

phrases.english: It’s sweltering — the sidewalk’s too hot to walk on barefoot.
phrases.chinese: 热得发烫——人行道烫得赤脚根本没法走。

phrases.english: It’s muggy — my shirt’s stuck to my back after two minutes outside.
phrases.chinese: 又闷又潮——我在外面待两分钟，衬衫就黏在后背上了。

phrases.english: It’s drizzling — not enough to open an umbrella, but enough to dampen everything.
phrases.chinese: 正下着毛毛雨——还不至于撑伞，但东西全被打潮了。

phrases.english: It’s snowing lightly — tiny flakes sticking to my coat sleeve.
phrases.chinese: 正飘着小雪——细小的雪花沾在我外套袖子上。

phrases.english: It’s sleeting — those icy pellets bounce off the pavement.
phrases.chinese: 正下着雨夹雪——那些冰粒砸在路面上还会弹起来。

phrases.english: That warm spring sun makes everything feel fresh and light.
phrases.chinese: 春日暖阳照在身上，一切都显得清新又轻快。

phrases.english: That dry winter air cracks my lips by noon — I’m reapplying balm constantly.
phrases.chinese: 冬日干燥的空气到中午就把我嘴唇干裂了——我得不停补润唇膏。

phrases.english: That heavy summer humidity makes stairs feel like a workout — even going up two flights.
phrases.chinese: 盛夏的湿热让爬楼梯都像在锻炼——哪怕只上两层楼。

phrases.english: Can we move the barbecue indoors? The grill’s already wet from the mist.
phrases.chinese: 烧烤能挪进屋里吗？烤架已经被水雾打湿了。

phrases.english: Can we postpone the laundry hang-out? That cloud bank looks like it’ll burst any minute.
phrases.chinese: 晾衣服能晚点再弄吗？那片云团眼看就要炸开下雨了。

phrases.english: Can we skip the morning run? The air feels thick and my lungs are tight.
phrases.chinese: 晨跑能免了吗？空气沉甸甸的，我肺部都有点发紧。

phrases.english: Wear your gloves — the wind’s sharp and my fingers went numb in seconds.
phrases.chinese: 戴上手套吧——风太刺骨，我手指几秒钟就麻了。

phrases.english: Layer up — the temperature dropped fast and the heater’s not kicking in.
phrases.chinese: 多穿点——气温掉得太快，暖气还没热起来。

phrases.english: Bring sunglasses — the sun’s low and blinding off the wet pavement.
phrases.chinese: 带上太阳镜吧——太阳位置低，反光在湿漉漉的路面上特别晃眼。

phrases.english: We’re switching to video call — the power just went out across the block.
phrases.chinese: 我们改视频会议吧——整条街刚停电了。

phrases.english: We’re canceling the rooftop event — the wind warning means no one can safely go up there.
phrases.chinese: 天台活动取消了——大风预警意味着没人能安全上去。

phrases.english: We’re closing early — the hailstorm cracked three skylights in under a minute.
phrases.chinese: 我们提前关门——冰雹不到一分钟就砸裂了三块天窗。

phrases.english: Ugh, another ‘cloudy with a chance of sun’ — which means gray all day.
phrases.chinese: 唉，又是‘多云间晴’——意思就是一整天都是灰蒙蒙的。

phrases.english: Ugh, another ‘windy’ forecast — but the trees aren’t moving and my hair’s flat.
phrases.chinese: 唉，预报又说‘有风’——可树纹丝不动，我头发还贴在脑门上。

phrases.english: Ugh, another ‘feels like’ temperature — but my thermometer says it’s ten degrees colder.
phrases.chinese: 唉，又是‘体感温度’——可我温度计显示比它低整整十度。

phrases.english: Hope the clouds break by noon — we’ve got photos scheduled on the balcony.
phrases.chinese: 希望中午前云能散开——我们约了在阳台拍照片。

phrases.english: Hope the rain holds off until after drop-off — the kids have no raincoats.
phrases.chinese: 希望放学前别下雨——孩子们都没带雨衣。

phrases.english: Hope the heat eases tonight — the fan’s loud and I can’t sleep.
phrases.chinese: 希望今晚热气能退一点——风扇声音太大，我睡不着。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: What time’s the next bus to Downtown?
phrases.chinese: 下一班开往市中心的公交车几点发车？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Does the 6:30 express to Harbor District run on holidays?
phrases.chinese: 开往海港区的6点30分快线节假日运行吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Is the last trolley to University Campus at 11:15 tonight?
phrases.chinese: 今晚最后一班开往大学城的有轨电车是11点15分吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Where’s the Blue Route shuttle stop?
phrases.chinese: 蓝线接驳车站在哪儿？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Is the Night Owl pickup inside the train station lobby?
phrases.chinese: 夜猫子专线在火车站大厅内上车吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Which building has the Tech Park shuttle drop-off?
phrases.chinese: 科技园接驳车在哪栋楼下车？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Do kids under ten ride free on city buses?
phrases.chinese: 十岁以下儿童坐市内公交车免费吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Is my transit card still good after today?
phrases.chinese: 我的交通卡过了今天还能用吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Can I pay cash for a light rail ride?
phrases.chinese: 轻轨单程能用现金付吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: The ferry’s delayed — what’s the new departure time?
phrases.chinese: 轮渡延误了，新的发船时间是几点？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: The tram’s stuck at Central Plaza — will it reach City Hall before 9 a.m.?
phrases.chinese: 有轨电车卡在中央广场站，能在上午9点前抵达市政厅站吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: This bike-share van hasn’t arrived — when’s the next pickup?
phrases.chinese: 这辆共享单车转运车还没到，下一次接驳是什么时候？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Let’s walk to the river path — it’s faster than the bus.
phrases.chinese: 咱们走河滨步道吧，比等公交车快。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: We’ll take the northbound metro — no transfers needed.
phrases.chinese: 咱们坐北行地铁吧，不用换乘。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Skip the tunnel — the riverside footbridge gets us there in six minutes.
phrases.chinese: 别走隧道了，走滨江人行桥六分钟就到了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: How long to walk from here to the old market?
phrases.chinese: 从这儿走到老市场要多久？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Is the botanical garden within ten minutes’ walk from Oak Street Station?
phrases.chinese: 植物园离橡树街站步行十分钟内能到吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Can I get to the community center on foot in under eight minutes?
phrases.chinese: 步行八分钟内能赶到社区中心吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Where’s the nearest dockless e-bike near the subway exit?
phrases.chinese: 地铁出口附近最近的无桩共享电单车在哪儿？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Do I need to park this e-bike in a designated zone?
phrases.chinese: 这辆电单车必须停在指定区域吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Are helmets provided with shared e-bikes at Riverside Landing?
phrases.chinese: 滨江码头的共享电单车配头盔吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: There’s an accident on Elm Street — what’s the fastest way around?
phrases.chinese: 榆树街发生事故了，最快绕行路线是什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: The bridge is closed for inspection — which streets go straight to the waterfront?
phrases.chinese: 大桥正在检修关闭，哪些街道能不绕路直达滨水区？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Pine Avenue construction has narrowed lanes — are parallel bike lanes open?
phrases.chinese: 松树大道施工导致车道变窄，旁边平行的自行车道还开放吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Is there metered parking on the south side of City Hall?
phrases.chinese: 市政厅南侧有收费停车位吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Do street-side spots near the theater require mobile payment?
phrases.chinese: 剧院周边的路边车位必须用手机付费吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Is the garage behind the library open for public parking after 6 p.m.?
phrases.chinese: 图书馆后面的停车场晚上6点后对公众开放吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: I’ll be picked up at the glass-roofed entrance of the transit hub.
phrases.chinese: 我会在交通枢纽带玻璃顶棚的入口处上车。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Drop me off at the taxi stand beside the clock tower.
phrases.chinese: 请在钟楼旁的出租车候客区让我下车。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in transport around town
phrases.english: Pickup’s at the covered ramp on the west side of the hospital.
phrases.chinese: 请到医院西侧带顶棚的坡道口接我。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you call me back in 20 minutes? I’m in a meeting.
phrases.chinese: 能20分钟后回我个电话吗？我现在在开会。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you call me back in 20 minutes? I’m in a meeting. My boss just walked in with the client.
phrases.chinese: 能20分钟后回我个电话吗？我现在在开会。老板刚带着客户进来了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you call me back in 20 minutes? I’m in a meeting. We’re reviewing the budget and it’s running long.
phrases.chinese: 能20分钟后回我个电话吗？我现在在开会。我们在审预算，会议拖得有点久。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you send a voice note? I can’t type right now.
phrases.chinese: 能发个语音条吗？我现在没法打字。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you send a voice note? I can’t type right now. I’m holding my toddler and the baby’s crying.
phrases.chinese: 能发个语音条吗？我现在没法打字。我正抱着大宝，小宝又在哭。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you send a voice note? I can’t type right now. I’m on the bus and it’s too bumpy.
phrases.chinese: 能发个语音条吗？我现在没法打字。我在公交车上，颠得太厉害了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Got it — thanks!
phrases.chinese: 收到了，谢谢！

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Got it — thanks! I’ll pick up the dry cleaning before lunch.
phrases.chinese: 收到了，谢谢！我午饭前去取干洗的衣服。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Got it — thanks! I’ll tell the landlord about the leak tonight.
phrases.chinese: 收到了，谢谢！我今晚就告诉房东漏水的事。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: What does ‘pending’ mean here? Is it done or still waiting?
phrases.chinese: 这里的‘pending’是什么意思？是办完了，还是还在等？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: What does ‘pending’ mean here? Is it done or still waiting? The app says ‘pending’ but my bank shows the money left.
phrases.chinese: 这里的‘pending’是什么意思？是办完了，还是还在等？App显示‘pending’，但我的银行账户里钱已经扣了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: What does ‘pending’ mean here? Is it done or still waiting? I clicked ‘submit’ twice and both say pending.
phrases.chinese: 这里的‘pending’是什么意思？是办完了，还是还在等？我点了两次‘提交’，两次都显示pending。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Let’s hop on a call — this is faster to sort out.
phrases.chinese: 咱们直接打电话吧——这样解决得快。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Let’s hop on a call — this is faster to sort out. I need to walk you through the login steps.
phrases.chinese: 咱们直接打电话吧——这样解决得快。我得一步步带你操作登录。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Let’s hop on a call — this is faster to sort out. We’ve sent six messages and it’s still confusing.
phrases.chinese: 咱们直接打电话吧——这样解决得快。我们来回发了六条消息，还是没理清。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Sorry I missed your call — is everything alright?
phrases.chinese: 抱歉没接到你电话——一切都还好吧？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Sorry I missed your call — is everything alright? My phone was in my coat pocket and I didn’t feel it ring.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉没接到你电话——一切都还好吧？手机在我外套口袋里，没感觉到震动。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Sorry I missed your call — is everything alright? I was helping my dad change his hearing aid batteries.
phrases.chinese: 抱歉没接到你电话——一切都还好吧？我正帮爸爸换助听器电池。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: What time works for a call tomorrow?
phrases.chinese: 明天什么时候打电话方便？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: What time works for a call tomorrow? I’m free after 2 p.m., but only until 3:30.
phrases.chinese: 明天什么时候打电话方便？我下午两点后有空，但只到三点半。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: What time works for a call tomorrow? I’m teaching a class from 10 to noon, so maybe late morning?
phrases.chinese: 明天什么时候打电话方便？我上午十点到中午要上课，那要不早点？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you text me the link? I can’t open emails right now.
phrases.chinese: 能把链接发我短信吗？我现在打不开邮件。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you text me the link? I can’t open emails right now. I’m using a public library computer.
phrases.chinese: 能把链接发我短信吗？我现在打不开邮件。我在用图书馆的公用电脑。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Can you text me the link? I can’t open emails right now. My phone’s stuck on the lock screen and won’t respond.
phrases.chinese: 能把链接发我短信吗？我现在打不开邮件。我手机卡在锁屏界面，没反应。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: I’ll reply tonight — I’m offline till then.
phrases.chinese: 我今晚回复——之前都收不到消息。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: I’ll reply tonight — I’m offline till then. I’m at a cabin with no Wi-Fi and only spotty cell service.
phrases.chinese: 我今晚回复——之前都收不到消息。我在一个没Wi-Fi、信号也不稳的小木屋里。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: I’ll reply tonight — I’m offline till then. My phone got wet and I’m waiting for it to dry out.
phrases.chinese: 我今晚回复——之前都收不到消息。我手机进水了，正在晾干。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Sending now — you’ll get it in a sec!
phrases.chinese: 马上发——几秒钟就到！

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Sending now — you’ll get it in a sec! It’s the photo from last night’s dinner.
phrases.chinese: 马上发——几秒钟就到！是昨晚晚饭的照片。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in phone and messages
phrases.english: Sending now — you’ll get it in a sec! I just added your name to the guest list.
phrases.chinese: 马上发——几秒钟就到！我刚把你的名字加进嘉宾名单了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: What do you enjoy doing when you're not busy?
phrases.chinese: 你平时不忙的时候，最喜欢做点啥？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Do you still take photos of street cats in the rain?
phrases.chinese: 你还在下雨天拍街边的猫吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Have you kept up with fixing old bikes in your garage?
phrases.chinese: 你还在车库里修老自行车吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I fold origami while listening to podcasts — it’s simple and calming.
phrases.chinese: 我听播客时折纸——简单又安心。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I rearrange my bookshelves by color every few months — no reason, just feels right.
phrases.chinese: 我每隔几个月就按颜色重排一次书架——没什么特别原因，就是觉得舒服。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I water my balcony plants at sunrise — quiet time before the day starts.
phrases.chinese: 我每天日出时给阳台的植物浇水——一天开始前的安静时刻。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Want to join me for a walk this weekend? No agenda, just moving slow.
phrases.chinese: 这周末想跟我一起散散步吗？不赶时间，就慢慢走走。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I’ll bring my sketchbook next time — just point out what’s worth drawing first.
phrases.chinese: 下次我带速写本——你先告诉我哪些东西值得画就行。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I’ve never tried this, but I’ll watch closely and copy what you do.
phrases.chinese: 我完全没试过，但会认真看，照着你的样子做。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I’m new at this — what’s the easiest thing to try first?
phrases.chinese: 我才刚接触这个——最容易上手的是哪一样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Are there beginner sessions that last under an hour?
phrases.chinese: 有没有那种不到一小时的初学者体验课？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: What’s the first tool someone should buy if they’re just starting pottery?
phrases.chinese: 刚学陶艺的人，第一件该买的工具是什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I only do things I can pause and pick up later — no long setups or deadlines.
phrases.chinese: 我只做能随时暂停、随时捡起来的事——不要复杂准备，也不设截止时间。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: If it needs more than twenty minutes of focus, I usually wait for another day.
phrases.chinese: 如果需要连续专注二十分钟以上，我一般就改天再做。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I don’t commit to anything that asks for regular attendance beyond two weeks.
phrases.chinese: 任何要求连续两周以上定期参加的活动，我都不加入。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: What’s the first thing that makes you smile when you start?
phrases.chinese: 你一上手，最先让你笑出来的是什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Is it the smell of fresh clay? The weight of the wheel? Or just how your shoulders relax?
phrases.chinese: 是新陶土的味道？拉坯机的重量？还是肩膀自然放松的感觉？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Is it the click of the shutter? The way light changes on the wall? Or just how your mind goes quiet?
phrases.chinese: 是快门声？墙上光线的变化？还是脑子一下子静下来的感觉？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Is there a gardening group that meets at the community plot on Wednesday evenings?
phrases.chinese: 社区菜园那边，周三晚上有园艺小队吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Does the neighborhood board game night still happen at the café on Main Street?
phrases.chinese: 邻里桌游夜还在主街那家咖啡馆办吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: Is there a casual hiking meetup at the hill trail on Sunday mornings?
phrases.chinese: 山丘步道那边，周日上午有轻松徒步小聚吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I started learning guitar last fall — now I strum three songs without looking.
phrases.chinese: 去年秋天我开始学吉他——现在弹三首歌都不用看手指了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I began journaling daily six months ago — filled my third notebook last week.
phrases.chinese: 半年前我开始每天写日记——上周刚填满第三本。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I took up calligraphy last winter — wrote my first full poem in ink last month.
phrases.chinese: 去年冬天我开始练书法——上个月第一次用墨水写完一首完整的诗。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I keep Sunday evenings free — that’s when I bake bread and listen to music.
phrases.chinese: 周日晚上我空着——那是我烤面包加听音乐的时间。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I don’t book anything after 7 p.m. — that’s my tea-and-reading hour.
phrases.chinese: 晚上七点后我不约事——那是我泡茶加读书的时间。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: I leave Tuesday lunchtimes open — that’s when I walk and call my sister.
phrases.chinese: 我周二午休时间永远空着——那是我边走边跟妹妹打电话的时间。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: We both love making soup — have you tried the farmers’ market stall with the big copper pot?
phrases.chinese: 我们都爱煮汤——你去过那个用大铜锅卖汤的农夫市集摊位吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: You collect vintage postcards — have you been to the flea market booth with the blue suitcase?
phrases.chinese: 你收老明信片——你去过那个用蓝色旧皮箱摆摊的跳蚤市场摊位吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in hobbies and free time
phrases.english: We both grow herbs on windowsills — have you found a good spot for basil near your kitchen sink?
phrases.chinese: 我们都爱在窗台上种香草——你在厨房水槽旁边找到适合种罗勒的位置了吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Is there a hardware store nearby that sells lightbulbs?
phrases.chinese: 附近有卖灯泡的五金店吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Does the corner deli carry organic oat milk?
phrases.chinese: 街角熟食店卖有机燕麦奶吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Is the family-run bakery on Maple Street open for weekend orders?
phrases.chinese: 枫树街那家家庭经营的面包房周末还接单吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: The sidewalk near the bus stop is cracked and uneven — someone could trip.
phrases.chinese: 公交站附近的 sidewalks 裂开了，高低不平，容易绊倒人。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Two street signs on Oak Avenue are missing — drivers keep turning the wrong way.
phrases.chinese: 橡树大道上有两个路牌不见了，司机老是走错方向。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: The communal mailbox lock hasn’t worked for over a week — mail is piling up inside.
phrases.chinese: 公共信箱的锁坏了快一周了，信件都堆在里头。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: You’ll love the coffee shop on 5th — their pastries are made fresh daily and they let you sit for hours.
phrases.chinese: 你一定会喜欢第五街那家咖啡馆——糕点每天现做，而且随便坐多久都没问题。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Try the laundromat on Elm — it’s clean, quiet, and has free Wi-Fi while you wait.
phrases.chinese: 可以试试榆树街的洗衣店，干净安静，等的时候还能免费用Wi-Fi。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: The bike repair stall in the farmers’ market fixes flats in under ten minutes — and they’re friendly.
phrases.chinese: 农夫市集里的自行车修理摊十分钟就能补好车胎，人也特别友善。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Is it safe to walk alone down River Road after dark? I’ve heard mixed things.
phrases.chinese: 天黑后独自走河滨路安全吗？我听大家说法不太一样。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Do people usually feel comfortable waiting at the 7th Street bus stop late at night?
phrases.chinese: 大家晚上在第七街公交站等车通常觉得安心吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Is the park behind the library well-lit and busy enough to feel safe at dusk?
phrases.chinese: 图书馆后面的公园傍晚时灯光够亮、人也够多，待着会觉得安心吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Is the neighborhood block party happening this Saturday like last year?
phrases.chinese: 邻里街区派对今年还会像去年那样在周六办吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
phrases.english: Are the free yoga classes in Riverside Park still running every Sunday morning?
phrases.chinese: 河滨公园每周日上午的免费瑜伽课今年还在开吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in neighborhood and services
