phrases.chinese: 12路公交在主火车站附近停靠吗？

phrases.english: What’s the quickest bus route from here to the museum?
phrases.chinese: 从这儿坐公交去博物馆最快走哪条线？

phrases.english: How do I get to the riverfront by tram only?
phrases.chinese: 只坐有轨电车怎么去河滨？

phrases.english: The ticket machine isn’t working.
phrases.chinese: 售票机坏了。

phrases.english: The gate won’t open when I tap my card.
phrases.chinese: 我刷了卡，闸门却打不开。

phrases.english: The real-time display at the stop is blank.
phrases.chinese: 站台上的实时信息屏是黑的。

phrases.english: Do I need to book a seat on this train?
phrases.chinese: 这趟火车要提前订座位吗？

phrases.english: Is seat reservation needed for the ferry to the island?
phrases.chinese: 去岛上的渡轮要订座位吗？

phrases.english: Do I have to reserve space for my large suitcase on the bus?
phrases.chinese: 我的大行李箱坐公交要提前占位置吗？

phrases.english: Where can I put my bag on this bus?
phrases.chinese: 我的包在这辆公交车上放哪儿？

phrases.english: Is there room for luggage near the front door?
phrases.chinese: 前门附近有地方放行李吗？

phrases.english: Can I keep my bike upright in the designated area?
phrases.chinese: 我能把自行车直立放在指定区域吗？

phrases.english: Could you let me know when we get to Central Square?
phrases.chinese: 到中心广场时，能请您提醒我一下吗？

phrases.english: Would you mind telling me before the next stop?
phrases.chinese: 下一站之前，能麻烦您告诉我一声吗？

phrases.english: Can you tell me when we’re approaching the university?
phrases.chinese: 快到大学站时，能请您提醒我吗？

phrases.english: Is there a reduced fare for seniors?
phrases.chinese: 老年人有优惠票价吗？

phrases.english: Are under-18s free on local transport?
phrases.chinese: 十八岁以下本地交通免费吗？

phrases.english: Is there a family rate for two adults and one child?
phrases.chinese: 两大一小有家庭票价吗？

phrases.english: I lost my paper ticket — what should I do?
phrases.chinese: 我把纸质车票弄丢了，该怎么办？

phrases.english: My phone died — can I still board with my e-ticket number?
phrases.chinese: 手机没电了，报电子票号能上车吗？

phrases.english: I didn’t get my e-ticket email — can you check it at the counter?
phrases.chinese: 我没收到电子票邮件，能在服务台查一下吗？

phrases.english: How do I change from the blue bus to the metro?
phrases.chinese: 怎么从蓝色公交换乘地铁？

phrases.english: What’s the best way to switch from the tram to the night bus?
phrases.chinese: 从有轨电车换乘夜间公交，最方便的方式是什么？

phrases.english: If the metro line is closed, which bus goes to the airport?
phrases.chinese: 如果地铁停运，哪路公交能到机场？

phrases.english: What’s ‘bouillabaisse’ — is it a fish stew?
phrases.chinese: ‘马赛鱼汤’是什么？是种鱼类炖菜吗？

phrases.english: Is ‘poutine’ just fries, cheese curds, and gravy?
phrases.chinese: ‘普丁’就只是薯条、奶酪凝块和肉汁吗？

phrases.english: Does ‘shakshuka’ always have eggs in it?
phrases.chinese: ‘沙克舒卡’里一定得有鸡蛋吗？

phrases.english: I’m allergic to peanuts — does the satay sauce contain peanut butter?
phrases.chinese: 我对花生过敏，沙嗲酱里含花生酱吗？

phrases.english: I can’t eat shellfish — is there any shrimp or crab in the chowder?
phrases.chinese: 我不能吃贝类，杂烩汤里有虾或蟹吗？

phrases.english: I need gluten-free food — is the soy sauce in this dish tamari?
phrases.chinese: 我需要无麸质食物，这道菜里的酱油是塔马利酱油吗？

phrases.english: What’s the most popular local dish here — the beef cheek or black pudding?
phrases.chinese: 这儿最受欢迎的本地菜是牛脸颊肉，还是黑布丁？

phrases.english: Is ‘cassoulet’ made with duck confit like in southern France?
phrases.chinese: ‘卡酥莱炖豆’像法国南部那样用鸭腿肉酱做的吗？

phrases.english: Do people usually eat ‘sauerbraten’ on Sundays in this region?
phrases.chinese: 当地人在这片区域通常周日吃‘德式炖牛肉’吗？

phrases.english: Is the large pizza enough for two adults?
phrases.chinese: 这个大号披萨够两个成年人吃吗？

phrases.english: Is the half portion meant to be a full meal for one person?
phrases.chinese: 这个半份是一人份主餐的量吗？

phrases.english: Will the tasting menu fill three people without dessert?
phrases.chinese: 如果不吃甜点，‘品鉴菜单’够三个人吃饱吗？

phrases.english: Can we split the bill three ways?
phrases.chinese: 我们能分三张账单结账吗？

phrases.english: Can you charge drinks and food to separate cards?
phrases.chinese: 酒水和食物能刷不同的卡吗？

phrases.english: Can we pay part now and part later?
phrases.chinese: 能现在付一部分，离开时再付剩下的吗？

phrases.english: Do you have a vegetarian main that isn’t pasta or rice?
phrases.chinese: 你们有不是意面或米饭做的素食主菜吗？

phrases.english: Is the mushroom risotto made with vegetable stock only?
phrases.chinese: 蘑菇烩饭只用蔬菜高汤做的吗？

phrases.english: Can I get the falafel plate without tahini?
phrases.chinese: 我能点一份不加芝麻酱的鹰嘴豆饼拼盘吗？

phrases.english: I ordered the chicken salad without croutons — these are on top.
phrases.chinese: 我点的鸡肉沙拉不要面包丁，可上面撒了。

phrases.english: I asked for no onions on the burger — but there’s raw onion in it.
phrases.chinese: 我要汉堡不加洋葱，可里面放了生洋葱。

phrases.english: This dairy-free ice cream has caramel — is the caramel made with milk?
phrases.chinese: 这杯无乳制品冰淇淋里有焦糖酱，那焦糖是用牛奶做的吗？

phrases.english: Can we get tap water — room temperature, no ice?
phrases.chinese: 能上自来水吗？常温的，不要冰。

phrases.english: Could we have two glasses of sparkling water — chilled, no lemon?
phrases.chinese: 请上两杯气泡水——冷藏的，不加柠檬。

phrases.english: Can we get still water in a pitcher — no ice, no garnish?
phrases.chinese: 能上一壶静水吗？不加冰，也不放装饰。

phrases.english: We’ll take the rest of the lasagna and garlic bread to go.
phrases.chinese: 剩下的千层面和蒜香面包我们打包带走。

phrases.english: Could you pack the soup and sandwich separately?
phrases.chinese: 能把汤和三明治分开打包吗？

phrases.english: Please wrap the brownie and ice cream in separate containers.
phrases.chinese: 请把布朗尼和冰淇淋分开放进两个容器。

phrases.english: The grilled halloumi was perfect — please tell the cook!
phrases.chinese: 烤哈罗米奶酪火候刚刚好，请一定告诉厨师！

phrases.english: That lentil soup was rich and smooth — please thank the kitchen.
phrases.chinese: 这碗扁豆汤味道醇厚顺滑，请替我们向厨房道谢。

phrases.english: The lemon tart was bright and not too sweet — please tell the pastry chef.
phrases.chinese: 柠檬挞酸香清爽、甜度刚好，请务必告诉点心师。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Can you confirm my 3 p.m. Shinkansen to Kyoto for two?
phrases.chinese: 能帮我确认一下下午3点去京都的新干线订单吗？两位。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Please confirm our three-night booking at Osaka Central Hostel starting tonight.
phrases.chinese: 请确认我们今晚起在大阪中央青年旅舍连住三晚的预订。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Can you confirm the Friday 2:15 p.m. flight from Fukuoka to Tokyo?
phrases.chinese: 能确认一下周五下午2点15分从福冈飞东京的航班吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: I didn’t get the e-ticket email — can you resend it?
phrases.chinese: 我没收到电子票邮件，能重新发一下吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: The e-ticket won’t open in the JR West app — please send a new one.
phrases.chinese: 电子票在JR西日本App里打不开，请重新发一张。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: My e-ticket QR code didn’t scan — can you email a new one now?
phrases.chinese: 我的电子票二维码扫不出来，能马上邮件发一张新的吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: What’s the cancellation fee for today’s 4:30 p.m. Narita Express seat?
phrases.chinese: 今天下午4点30分成田特快座位取消要收多少手续费？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: What’s the fee to cancel the 9 a.m. ferry to Miyajima?
phrases.chinese: 上午9点去宫岛的渡轮取消要收多少手续费？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: How much is the fee if I cancel the 7 p.m. airport shuttle before 5 p.m.?
phrases.chinese: 如果在下午5点前取消晚上7点的机场接驳车，手续费是多少？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: My name is misspelled on the ticket — it should be ‘Jennifer Lee’.
phrases.chinese: 票上我的名字拼错了，应该是‘Jennifer Lee’。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: The ticket says ‘Tanaka-Smith’, but my real name is ‘Tanaka Smith’ — please correct it.
phrases.chinese: 票上写的是‘Tanaka-Smith’，但我真实姓名是‘Tanaka Smith’，请更正。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: My middle name ‘Kenji’ is missing — only ‘Robert Chen’ shows up. Please add it.
phrases.chinese: 我的中间名‘Kenji’漏掉了，只显示了‘Robert Chen’，请补上。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Can you email the full itinerary with times, platforms, and booking ID?
phrases.chinese: 能麻烦您把完整行程单发我邮箱吗？包括时间、站台号和订单号。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Please email the itinerary for our family bus trip — four adults, pickup at Shinjuku Bus Terminal, check-in at Hotel Kyo at 4 p.m.
phrases.chinese: 请把我们四人家庭巴士行程单发我邮箱——新宿巴士总站上车，下午4点在京都酒店入住。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: I need the itinerary for the Kyoto walking tour — start time, meeting point at Nishiki Market, and total length.
phrases.chinese: 我需要京都徒步游的行程单——出发时间、锦市场集合地点和全程时长。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: We’re six adults booking the same 11 a.m. Mt. Fuji bus tour — is there a group discount?
phrases.chinese: 我们六位成人一起订上午11点的富士山巴士团，有团体折扣吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Eight of us are booking identical Nozomi tickets for tomorrow’s 10:20 a.m. train — do you offer group rates?
phrases.chinese: 我们八人订明天上午10点20分同班希望号列车票，提供团体票价吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Our school group of twelve is taking the July 12 ferry to Naoshima — do student group fares apply?
phrases.chinese: 我们十二名学生7月12日乘渡轮去直岛，适用学生团体票价吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: I booked the local train instead of the Shinkansen — can you change it?
phrases.chinese: 我不小心订了普通列车，其实想订新干线，能改成新干线吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: I chose aisle seat 8D, but got window seat 8C — please switch it.
phrases.chinese: 我选的是8D过道座，却分配了8C窗座，请换成8D。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: My booking says Haneda, but I need Narita — please fix the airport.
phrases.chinese: 订单写的是羽田机场，但我需要成田机场——请更正机场信息。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: We’d like two side-by-side aisle seats on the 5 p.m. Takamatsu express — are any available?
phrases.chinese: 我们想要下午5点开往高松的特快列车上两个并排的过道座，还有空位吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Can I book two window seats next to each other on the 10 a.m. Hakone bus?
phrases.chinese: 我能订上午10点开往箱根的巴士上两个相邻的窗边座吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Are there any facing seat pairs left on tonight’s 7 p.m. Naoshima ferry?
phrases.chinese: 今晚晚上7点开往直岛的渡轮上，还有面对面的双人座吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Can I upgrade this Hokuriku Shinkansen seat to Gran Class? How much?
phrases.chinese: 我能把这趟北陆新干线的座位升级成Gran车厢吗？加多少钱？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Is upgrading to Green Car possible for the 6 p.m. Tokaido Shinkansen? What’s the cost?
phrases.chinese: 能把晚上6点东海道新干线的座位升级成绿色车厢吗？要加多少钱？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: What’s the cost to upgrade from standard double to premium suite at Kyoto Garden Hotel?
phrases.chinese: 从京都花园酒店的标准双床房升级到高级套房要加多少钱？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: I just paid by credit card — is the reservation confirmed?
phrases.chinese: 我刚用信用卡付了款——订单已确认了吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: The card payment went through — is the booking status ‘confirmed’?
phrases.chinese: 信用卡付款已成功——订单状态是‘已确认’吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in tickets and bookings
phrases.english: Payment is complete — is the reservation locked?
phrases.chinese: 付款已完成——该订单已锁定吗？

phrases.english: My passport was stolen — where do I report it?
phrases.chinese: 我的护照被盗了——我该去哪儿报案？

phrases.english: My ID card is missing — is there a police station nearby?
phrases.chinese: 我的身份证不见了——附近有派出所吗？

phrases.english: My residence permit was taken at the metro gate — who handles that?
phrases.chinese: 我的居留许可在地铁闸口被拿走了——这事该找谁报备？

phrases.english: I need emergency medical help — is there a clinic open now?
phrases.chinese: 我需要紧急医疗救助——现在有开门的诊所吗？

phrases.english: My father collapsed on the street — can I call an ambulance right now?
phrases.chinese: 我父亲在街上晕倒了——我现在能马上叫救护车吗？

phrases.english: I cut my arm badly and it won’t stop bleeding — where’s the nearest urgent care?
phrases.chinese: 我手臂被严重割伤，血一直止不住——最近的急诊点在哪儿？

phrases.english: I need to see a doctor now — do you have staff who speak English?
phrases.chinese: 我得马上看医生——你们有会说英语的医护人员吗？

phrases.english: My baby stopped breathing after choking — can we get to a doctor right away?
phrases.chinese: 宝宝噎住后停止呼吸了——我们能立刻看医生吗？

phrases.english: Half my face feels numb — is there a hospital with emergency neurology?
phrases.chinese: 我半边脸发麻——附近有提供神经科急诊的医院吗？

phrases.english: I left my backpack on the subway — how do I report it lost?
phrases.chinese: 我把背包落在地铁上了——怎么报失？

phrases.english: I forgot my coat with my boarding pass on the airport bus — who should I tell first?
phrases.chinese: 我把带着登机牌的大衣忘在机场巴士上了——我该先告诉谁？

phrases.english: My wallet disappeared from the hotel sofa — does security check the cameras?
phrases.chinese: 我的钱包从酒店沙发上不见了——安保人员会查监控吗？

phrases.english: I’m a US citizen and my passport was stolen — how do I reach the American Embassy?
phrases.chinese: 我是美国公民，护照被盗了——怎么联系美国大使馆？

phrases.english: I’m from New Zealand and lost all my ID — what’s the embassy’s emergency number?
phrases.chinese: 我来自新西兰，所有证件都丢了——大使馆的紧急电话是多少？

phrases.english: I’m South African and had all my documents stolen at the market — how do I get replacement papers?
phrases.chinese: 我是南非人，在集市上所有证件都被偷了——怎么补办证件？

phrases.english: I don’t have ID or a driver’s license — will my student card work for check-in?
phrases.chinese: 我没有身份证或驾照——学生证能用来办理值机吗？

phrases.english: I only have an old work permit and a phone bill — can I rent a car with these?
phrases.chinese: 我只有一张过期的工作许可和一张手机账单——凭这些能租到车吗？

phrases.english: My passport is being renewed — will a printed visa approval letter get me into the museum?
phrases.chinese: 我的护照正在更新——打印出来的签证批准函能让我进博物馆吗？

phrases.english: A man said he was airport security and took my wallet — that’s not real, is it?
phrases.chinese: 有个男人自称是机场安检，把我的钱包拿走了——这肯定不是真的，对吧？

phrases.english: They told me my ticket needed ‘verification’ and asked for a code on their phone — that’s fake, right?
phrases.chinese: 他们说我的票要‘验证’，还让我在他们的手机上输验证码——这肯定是假的，对吧？

phrases.english: Someone at immigration offered to process my visa faster for cash — that’s illegal, isn’t it?
phrases.chinese: 入境处有人主动提出收钱帮我加急办签证——这肯定是违法的，对吧？

phrases.english: My flight was cancelled — how do I claim back my hotel and meal costs?
phrases.chinese: 我的航班取消了——怎么索赔酒店和餐食费用？

phrases.english: Baggage handlers broke my suitcase — what photos do I need for the insurance claim?
phrases.chinese: 行李搬运员弄坏了我的行李箱——保险理赔需要拍哪些照片？

phrases.english: My ferry was delayed and I missed my prepaid tour — how do I get a full refund?
phrases.chinese: 渡轮延误导致我错过了已付款的观光团——怎么申请全额退款？

phrases.english: I can’t fill out this customs form — can someone help me get it right?
phrases.chinese: 我不会填这张海关表格——能请人帮我填对吗？

phrases.english: This health form asks for my doctor’s details — I’m traveling alone and don’t have them — what should I write?
phrases.chinese: 这份健康表格要填我医生的信息——但我独自旅行，根本没带这些——我该写什么？

phrases.english: The tax refund form lists things I didn’t buy — can you check it against my receipt?
phrases.chinese: 这张退税表格列了我没买的东西——您能对照我的购物小票核对一下吗？

phrases.english: I need to catch the 6:30 ferry — where exactly is the dock?
phrases.chinese: 我得赶6:30那班渡轮——码头到底在哪儿？

phrases.english: I must return my rental car by 8:00 — which entrance goes straight to the drop-off counter?
phrases.chinese: 我必须8点前还租的车——哪个入口能直接到还车柜台？

phrases.english: I have a visa appointment at 9:15 — what’s the quickest way from this subway station?
phrases.chinese: 我9点15分有签证预约——从这个地铁站过去最快怎么走？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Where do locals grab coffee without the crowds?
phrases.chinese: 当地人不挤、能安静喝咖啡的地方在哪儿？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Which bakery lets neighbors pick up fresh buns at 6 a.m. — not just tour groups?
phrases.chinese: 哪家包子铺早上六点就让街坊来买新鲜包子——不是只接待旅行团那种？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Is there a fruit stand where regulars chat while waiting for the morning delivery?
phrases.chinese: 有没有个水果摊，老主顾们边等早上的货边聊天那种？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Do I pay to walk into the old city gate?
phrases.chinese: 进老城门要付钱吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Is entry free for seniors at the pottery workshop?
phrases.chinese: 老年人进陶艺工坊免费吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Can I go inside the clock tower without a ticket?
phrases.chinese: 不买票能进钟楼里面吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: When do the dumpling stalls set up in the square?
phrases.chinese: 饺子摊几点在广场支摊？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Does the lantern-making class run on Mondays?
phrases.chinese: 做灯笼课周一开吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Are the boat rides on the canal still going at 5 p.m.?
phrases.chinese: 运河游船五点还开吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Where’s a clear view of the archway without people walking through?
phrases.chinese: 拍拱门不被路人穿过的干净角度在哪儿？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Which side of the bridge has even light for photos before noon?
phrases.chinese: 桥哪一侧上午前光线均匀，适合拍照？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Is the bench under the red umbrella good for photos of the pagoda?
phrases.chinese: 红伞下的长凳，拍宝塔的照片可以吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Should I take my shoes off before entering the courtyard?
phrases.chinese: 进院子前得脱鞋吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Do kids sit cross-legged during the tea service?
phrases.chinese: 小孩参加茶会要盘腿坐吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Is it okay to point with my chopsticks at the altar?
phrases.chinese: 用筷子指着神龛可以吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Where do the English tours meet — near the post office or the bridge?
phrases.chinese: 英文团在邮局附近还是桥边集合？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Do the food walks start from the market entrance or the alley behind it?
phrases.chinese: 美食漫步是从市场入口开始，还是从它后面那条小巷开始？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Which door do the walking tours use — the one by the well or the garden gate?
phrases.chinese: 步行游走的是水井旁那扇门，还是花园门？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Does the lantern festival happen at the lake this year?
phrases.chinese: 今年灯笼节在湖边办吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Are drum performances part of the harvest fair at the temple grounds?
phrases.chinese: 庙前空地的丰收节有打鼓表演吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Do families gather at the riverside for the mooncake event?
phrases.chinese: 一家人中秋赏月吃月饼是在河滨聚会吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Do they hand out maps at the ferry terminal desk?
phrases.chinese: 轮渡码头问讯处发地图吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Is there a map holder by the bus stop with street names in English?
phrases.chinese: 公交站旁有放英文路名地图的架子吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Can I get a neighborhood map at the small shop next to the clinic?
phrases.chinese: 诊所旁边那家小店能拿到街区地图吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Where do people buy real silk scarves woven here?
phrases.chinese: 真丝围巾本地织的，在哪儿买得到？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Which stall sells wooden combs carved by elders in the village?
phrases.chinese: 哪个摊卖村里老人亲手雕的木梳？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Is there a place that sells rice wine bottled by local families?
phrases.chinese: 有没有本地家庭自酿、自装瓶的米酒卖？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Is it safe to walk back from the night market alone after 11?
phrases.chinese: 晚上十一点后独自从夜市走回去安全吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Do women usually walk the path behind the library after dark?
phrases.chinese: 晚上天黑后，女性常走图书馆后面那条路吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in sightseeing and local advice
phrases.english: Are the streets around the old theater well-lit at night?
phrases.chinese: 老剧院周边的街道夜里灯亮吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The breakroom looks so much nicer with those new plants.
phrases.chinese: 休息室添了那些新绿植，看着舒服多了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The open layout in the west corner makes meetings feel less cramped.
phrases.chinese: 西角这片开放式布局让开会再也不觉得挤了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: That quiet nook by the water cooler is perfect for quick calls.
phrases.chinese: 饮水机边那个小角落，打个短电话再合适不过了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The new lighting in the main hallway cuts down on eye strain.
phrases.chinese: 主走廊换的新灯，眼睛不那么累了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: How did your weekend go?
phrases.chinese: 你周末过得咋样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Get any time to yourself this weekend?
phrases.chinese: 这周末有属于自己的时间吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Anything low-key and relaxing happen?
phrases.chinese: 有啥轻松放松的小事发生吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Hope you got a little breathing room — I sure did.
phrases.chinese: 希望你也喘了口气——我可是真歇过来了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: We just finished the team sync for Q2.
phrases.chinese: 我们刚开完二季度团队同步会。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Everyone joined the cross-team workshop this morning.
phrases.chinese: 今早所有人都参加了跨组工作坊。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: We ran through the new onboarding checklist together.
phrases.chinese: 我们一起过了一遍新版入职清单。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The whole group reviewed last week’s project notes.
phrases.chinese: 整个小组一起看了上周的项目记录。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: How was your ride in today?
phrases.chinese: 今天通勤路上咋样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Was traffic lighter than usual this morning?
phrases.chinese: 今早车流比平时少点吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Did the bus run on schedule? It’s been spotty lately.
phrases.chinese: 公交准点吗？最近老不准时。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Any trouble finding parking near the entrance?
phrases.chinese: 入口附近停车还难找吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: This shared calendar keeps us all in the same time zone.
phrases.chinese: 这个共享日历让我们所有人时间都对得上。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The auto-scheduling tool just saved me twenty minutes.
phrases.chinese: 自动排期工具刚帮我省了二十分钟。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Search in our chat history actually pulls up what I need.
phrases.chinese: 在聊天记录里一搜，真能找到我要的。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The file version history stopped me from overwriting someone else’s edits.
phrases.chinese: 文件版本记录帮我躲开了覆盖别人修改的坑。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: My day’s packed — back-to-back all morning.
phrases.chinese: 我今天排得满满当当——上午全是连轴转。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Three calls before 10, and still haven’t touched my to-do list.
phrases.chinese: 十点前开了三场会，待办清单还没碰过。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Just came from a two-hour deep-dive — brain feels fuzzy.
phrases.chinese: 刚结束两小时深度讨论，脑子有点发懵。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Every time I sit down, something urgent pops up.
phrases.chinese: 我刚坐定，立刻就有急事冒出来。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Heading to the café downstairs for lunch — coming along?
phrases.chinese: 我下楼去楼下咖啡馆吃午饭，一块儿去不？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Grabbing sandwiches from the deli — want half?
phrases.chinese: 我去熟食店买三明治，分你一半？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Taking leftovers to the balcony — joining the sunshine crew?
phrases.chinese: 我带剩饭去天台吃，加入阳光午餐队吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Picking up soup and salad from the food truck — sharing?
phrases.chinese: 我去餐车买汤和沙拉，一起分着吃？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Heard about the new remote work policy — nice change.
phrases.chinese: 听说了新远程办公政策，挺好的调整。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The updated PTO accrual kicked in Monday — already planning a day off.
phrases.chinese: 新的年假累积规则周一生效了，我已在盘算休哪天。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Saw the office snack rotation starts next week — looking forward to it.
phrases.chinese: 看到办公室零食轮换下周开始，还挺期待的。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: The new feedback channel went live yesterday — used it right away.
phrases.chinese: 新反馈通道昨天上线了，我立马试用了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: How’s your day going?
phrases.chinese: 你今天咋样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Still holding up okay, or getting swamped?
phrases.chinese: 还撑得住，还是快被事情淹没了？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Any wins worth celebrating so far?
phrases.chinese: 到现在有啥值得高兴的小进展吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Keeping up with everything, or needing a breather?
phrases.chinese: 所有事都跟得上，还是需要缓口气？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Your desk setup is so clean and easy to use.
phrases.chinese: 你的工位布置得又清爽又顺手。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Love how simple and functional your monitor stand is.
phrases.chinese: 真喜欢你显示器支架这么简洁又实用。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: Everything on your shelf has its own spot — makes sense.
phrases.chinese: 你架子上每样东西都有固定位置，看着就合理。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in workplace small talk
phrases.english: That bulletin board is full of useful stuff — and not too busy.
phrases.chinese: 那块公告板贴的都是实用信息，又不显得杂乱。

phrases.english: What’s the one thing we need to decide before this meeting ends?
phrases.chinese: 咱们这场会结束前，最需要敲定的一件事是什么？

phrases.english: Before we go further — what’s the single decision we must make today?
phrases.chinese: 在继续之前——咱们今天必须做出的唯一决定是什么？

phrases.english: What question does this meeting exist to answer?
phrases.chinese: 这场会存在的目的，就是要回答什么问题？

phrases.english: What can’t we walk out of here without agreeing on?
phrases.chinese: 咱们离场前，哪件事不达成一致就不算开完会？

phrases.english: So the rollout depends on the audit being done.
phrases.chinese: 所以上线得等审计做完。

phrases.english: The biggest issue across all teams is delayed CRM access.
phrases.chinese: 所有团队反馈里最突出的问题是CRM权限开通延迟。

phrases.english: Everyone keeps pointing to handoff gaps between sales and onboarding.
phrases.chinese: 销售和客户成功团队之间交接不顺，这是大家反复提到的问题。

phrases.english: All beta users say the search filter resets itself.
phrases.chinese: 所有测试用户都说搜索筛选器会自己重置。

phrases.english: Is the agenda set — or should we drop, move, or shorten something?
phrases.chinese: 议程已经定了吗？还是需要删掉、调整顺序或压缩某项？

phrases.english: Should we move budget approval up? The CFO leaves at noon.
phrases.chinese: 预算审批要不要提前？首席财务官中午就走了。

phrases.english: Can we skip vendor comparison? We already picked the shortlist.
phrases.chinese: 供应商对比能跳过吗？入围名单昨天就定了。

phrases.english: Do we still need 25 minutes for security? The report went out this morning.
phrases.chinese: 安全简报还要留25分钟吗？报告今早已经发了。

phrases.english: I’ll draft the policy and share it for review by tomorrow noon.
phrases.chinese: 我来起草政策初稿，明天中午前发出来请大家审阅。

phrases.english: I’ll compile the test notes and send key takeaways before Monday’s stand-up.
phrases.chinese: 我来汇总测试记录，周一晨会前把关键要点发给大家。

phrases.english: I’ll write the incident playbook and send it to legal and engineering for sign-off.
phrases.chinese: 我来写好事件响应手册，发给法务和研发签字确认。

phrases.english: I’ll set up the workshop and send invites with pre-reads by end of day.
phrases.chinese: 我来安排工作坊，今天下班前发出带预读材料的日历邀请。

phrases.english: Who’s confirming the final stakeholder list?
phrases.chinese: 最终相关方名单由谁确认？

phrases.english: Who’s signing off on the escalation matrix?
phrases.chinese: 升级处理矩阵由谁最终批准？

phrases.english: Who’s checking the localization checklist against target markets?
phrases.chinese: 本地化核对清单由谁对照目标市场核验？

phrases.english: Who’s approving the new data retention schedule?
phrases.chinese: 新版数据保留周期表由谁批准？

phrases.english: Can I jump in to ask who owns the call on hiring freeze extension?
phrases.chinese: 我能插一句，问问招聘冻结延期的最终决定权在谁那儿？

phrases.english: Can I jump in to ask who’s handling the accessibility fix timeline?
phrases.chinese: 我能插一句，问问无障碍整改的时间节点谁在盯？

phrases.english: Can I jump in to confirm who’s leading the customer comms plan?
phrases.chinese: 我能插一句，确认下客户沟通方案谁在牵头？

phrases.english: Can I jump in to check who’s delivering the vendor risk report?
phrases.chinese: 我能插一句，确认下供应商风险评估报告谁来交？

phrases.english: Who can quickly recap the three vendor selection criteria?
phrases.chinese: 谁能快速回顾一下供应商选择的三项标准？

phrases.english: Who can walk us through the QBR deck structure?
phrases.chinese: 谁能帮我们过一遍季度复盘汇报的框架？

phrases.english: Who can summarize the remote work policy changes next month?
phrases.chinese: 谁能总结一下下月远程办公政策有哪些变化？

phrases.english: Who can restate the two must-haves for the product launch?
phrases.chinese: 谁能重申一下产品发布必须满足的两个条件？

phrases.english: Let’s park office layout redesign until after the headcount review.
phrases.chinese: 办公室布局重新设计先搁一搁，等人员编制评审完再说。

phrases.english: Let’s hold documentation standards until the API spec is done.
phrases.chinese: 文档规范先缓一缓，等API接口说明定稿再谈。

phrases.english: Let’s defer performance template revision until HR shares the new framework.
phrases.chinese: 绩效模板修订先放一放，等人力资源部发布新能力框架再说。

phrases.english: Let’s table offline mode scope until UX validation wraps up.
phrases.chinese: 离线模式功能范围先放一放，等用户体验验证结束再议。

phrases.english: Who needs to join the compliance workshop live — and who just needs the summary?
phrases.chinese: 监管合规工作坊谁必须实时参会？谁只需看总结就行？

phrases.english: Who from finance and tax needs real-time input on transfer pricing?
phrases.chinese: 转让定价环节，财务和税务谁需要实时参与并提意见？

phrases.english: Who on marketing co-writes the campaign brief — and who just reviews it?
phrases.chinese: 营销团队中谁一起写活动简报？谁只负责审阅？

phrases.english: Who’s required for the infrastructure review — and who just needs the decision log?
phrases.chinese: 基础设施评审谁必须出席？谁只需了解决策日志就行？

phrases.english: Does Thursday at 11 a.m. still work for the roadmap sync?
phrases.chinese: 产品路线图同步会周四上午11点，时间还合适吗？

phrases.english: How about Wednesday at 4 p.m. for the advisory board prep?
phrases.chinese: 客户顾问委员会筹备会周三下午4点，怎么样？

phrases.english: Would Friday at 10 a.m. work for the sprint retrospective?
phrases.chinese: 冲刺复盘会周五上午10点，大家方便吗？

phrases.english: Is Monday at 2 p.m. open for leadership alignment — or try Tuesday?
phrases.chinese: 领导层对齐会周一两点可以吗？还是周二更合适？

phrases.english: What’s the one thing we absolutely must finish before tomorrow’s review?
phrases.chinese: 明天评审前，我们绝对必须完成的那一件事是什么？

phrases.english: Does the vendor contract need sign-off before compliance clears, or can it wait till Friday?
phrases.chinese: 供应商合同必须在合规审批通过前签字确认，还是可以等到周五？

phrases.english: Must the prototype demo be ready before engineering sync, or is Thursday morning okay?
phrases.chinese: 原型演示必须在工程同步会前准备好，还是周四上午完成也可以？

phrases.english: Is fixing the API timeout more urgent than finalizing rollout?
phrases.chinese: 修复API超时问题比敲定上线计划更紧急吗？

phrases.english: Where does this rank among the other three right now?
phrases.chinese: 这件事目前在其余三项中排第几？

phrases.english: Has the security patch moved ahead of UI tweaks in this sprint?
phrases.chinese: 安全补丁在这次迭代中已经排到UI微调前面了吗？

phrases.english: Is client feedback integration still ranked above analytics dashboard update?
phrases.chinese: 客户反馈整合的优先级目前仍高于数据分析仪表盘更新吗？

phrases.english: Did the team move server config review ahead of documentation cleanup for this release?
phrases.chinese: 团队是否已将服务器配置审查排在本次发布的文档整理之前？

phrases.english: We can’t start next phase until client signs off — is that deadline still firm?
phrases.chinese: 客户签字确认后才能启动下一阶段——这个截止日仍是不可调整的吗？

phrases.english: Audit report sign-off is locked for Thursday — nothing else takes priority until then.
phrases.chinese: 审计报告签字确认已锁定为周四完成——在此之前，其他任何事项都不能优先处理。

phrases.english: Public demo can’t go live without login flow fix — is Wednesday the final deadline?
phrases.chinese: 没有登录流程修复，公开演示就无法上线——周三是最终截止日吗？

phrases.english: No feature can ship until compliance checklist passes — is that confirmed with Legal?
phrases.chinese: 合规检查清单未通过前，任何功能都不能发布——这一点已获得法务团队确认了吗？

phrases.english: I’ll take full ownership of the budget report — so pause dashboard redesign now.
phrases.chinese: 我全权负责预算报告——所以数据仪表盘改版现在就暂停。

phrases.english: She’s taking full ownership of vendor contracts Monday — so no approvals move forward without her input.
phrases.chinese: 她从下周一全权负责供应商合同——所有审批都需经她确认后才能推进。

phrases.english: I’ll own the investor presentation — I lead all messaging, but slides and data stay with analyst team.
phrases.chinese: 我负责投资人汇报陈述——所有话术由我主导，但PPT制作和数据准备仍由分析团队承担。

phrases.english: I’ll handle all server config updates and rollbacks — no one else touches production configs this week.
phrases.chinese: 服务器配置的所有更新与回滚均由我处理——本周内任何人不得修改生产环境配置。

phrases.english: So only audit sign-off is holding up launch — nothing else is pending?
phrases.chinese: 所以只有审计签字在阻碍上线——其他环节都已就绪，对吗？

phrases.english: Just confirming: is security patch the only blocker for QA handoff?
phrases.chinese: 再确认一下：安全补丁是QA交接的唯一阻碍吗？

phrases.english: If client feedback isn’t integrated by Wednesday, does the demo get pushed — or do we cut scope?
phrases.chinese: 如果客户反馈周三前还没整合进去，演示是推迟，还是我们主动缩减范围？

phrases.english: Is prototype demo truly the only requirement before stakeholder review — no docs or test reports needed?
phrases.chinese: 原型演示确实是利益相关方评审前的唯一要求吗——不需要配套文档或测试报告？

phrases.english: We have three fixed deadlines this week — which one absolutely can’t move?
phrases.chinese: 这周我们有三个固定截止日——哪一个绝对不能延后？

phrases.english: Both redesign and compliance update need legal sign-off this week — which one gets legal’s time first?
phrases.chinese: 改版和合规更新这周都需要法务签字——法务团队的时间该优先分配给哪一项？

phrases.english: If QA testing hasn’t started by Tuesday, the launch date slips — do we shrink features or extend timeline?
phrases.chinese: 如果周二前QA测试仍未启动，上线日期就会延期——我们是精简功能集，还是延长整体周期？

phrases.english: Investor call is fixed for Thursday — if deck isn’t finalized by Tuesday, what’s our approved fallback message?
phrases.chinese: 投资人会议时间已锁定为周四——如果周二前PPT尚未最终定稿，我们的官方备用话术是什么？

phrases.english: Let’s pause dashboard redesign and assign two engineers to security patch now.
phrases.chinese: 咱们先暂停数据仪表盘改版，立刻抽调两名工程师专攻安全补丁。

phrases.english: Can we move team sync to Friday so engineering can focus on audit sign-off through Thursday?
phrases.chinese: 咱们能把团队同步会挪到周五吗？这样工程团队就能集中精力确保周四完成审计签字。

phrases.english: Let’s defer API documentation until timeout fix is verified in staging.
phrases.chinese: API文档编写暂缓，等超时问题修复在预发环境验证通过后再启动。

phrases.english: What if we block one engineer for client feedback integration and make it top item in tomorrow’s stand-up?
phrases.chinese: 要是把客户反馈整合安排为明天站会的第一项议题，并为此预留一名工程师的整块时间，你觉得如何？

phrases.english: I’m fully aligned with the launch goal — where should engineering hours go first?
phrases.chinese: 我全力支持上线目标——工程人力应最先聚焦在哪一项？

phrases.english: I’m fully aligned with Q3 reporting goal — should clean data extraction take priority over dashboard polish this sprint?
phrases.chinese: 我全力支持第三季度报表目标——本迭代中，数据提取的准确性应优先于仪表盘美化吗？

phrases.english: I’m fully aligned with client demo goal — is script finalization more critical than rehearsal timing?
phrases.chinese: 我全力支持客户演示目标——讲稿定稿比排练时间安排更关键吗？

phrases.english: I’m fully aligned with compliance goal — should legal review happen before internal testing begins?
phrases.chinese: 我全力支持合规目标——法务审核应在内部测试启动前完成吗？

phrases.english: I can only deliver one high-impact item this week — which gives the clearest business value?
phrases.chinese: 我这周只能交付一项高影响力成果——哪一项能带来最明确的业务价值？

phrases.english: I can deliver one item before Friday — vendor contract or compliance checklist?
phrases.chinese: 我周五前能交付一项成果——该选供应商合同还是合规检查清单？

phrases.english: I only have two half-days available this week — which task gives us the strongest signal to stakeholders?
phrases.chinese: 我这周只有两个半天可投入工作——哪项任务能向利益相关方传递最强有力的进展信号？

phrases.english: I’ll be offline Thursday and Friday — what’s the single most critical thing to finish before Thursday?
phrases.chinese: 我周四和周五不在线——周四下班前最该完成的一件事是什么？

phrases.english: So scope freeze is next Tuesday — and no changes are allowed after that?
phrases.chinese: 所以范围冻结日是下周二——此后不再接受任何变更？

phrases.english: Is design sign-off deadline firm, or can engineering adjust it if they hit technical blockers?
phrases.chinese: 设计签字截止日是刚性的，还是说工程团队若遇到技术阻碍，有权调整该日期？

phrases.english: Does ‘final scope’ mean no new features *and* no scope refinements — or just no new features?
phrases.chinese: 所谓‘最终范围’，是指既不接受新功能，也不允许范围细化，还是仅指不接受新功能？

phrases.english: Stakeholder input cutoff is this Friday — and no extensions will be granted, right?
phrases.chinese: 利益相关方提意见的截止时间是这周五——且不接受任何延期，对吗？

phrases.english: The onboarding checklist is done — team leads can use it now.
phrases.chinese: 入职检查清单已完成，团队负责人现在即可使用。

phrases.english: The vendor contract is signed — procurement says it’s live.
phrases.chinese: 供应商合同已签署——采购部确认已生效。

phrases.english: All test environments are ready — dev teams started testing this morning.
phrases.chinese: 所有测试环境均已就绪——开发团队今早已开始测试。

phrases.english: The Q3 marketing plan is up — anyone with access can see it.
phrases.chinese: 第三季度市场计划已上线——所有有权限者均可查看。

phrases.english: The new org chart is out — managers got it this afternoon.
phrases.chinese: 新版组织架构图已发布——管理者今下午已收到。

phrases.english: Customer survey results are in the dashboard — raw data is there too.
phrases.chinese: 客户调研结果已上传至仪表盘——原始数据也在其中。

phrases.english: We’re waiting on legal — they haven’t sent the draft back yet.
phrases.chinese: 我们正等法务——他们尚未返回草案。

phrases.english: We can’t ship — the app store review isn’t done yet.
phrases.chinese: 我们无法发布——应用商店审核尚未完成。

phrases.english: Testing can’t start — the test server still isn’t responding.
phrases.chinese: 测试无法启动——测试服务器仍无响应。

phrases.english: I’ll finish the user guide by lunch and put it in the shared folder.
phrases.chinese: 我午饭前完成用户指南，并放入共享文件夹。

phrases.english: She’s finishing the training slides — sending them before 2 p.m.
phrases.chinese: 她正在收尾培训幻灯片——下午两点前发出。

phrases.english: They’re wrapping up the handover notes — done by end of day.
phrases.chinese: 他们正在收尾交接说明——下班前完成。

phrases.english: Should the release notes include screenshots, or stay text-only?
phrases.chinese: 发布说明是否需要包含截图，还是保持纯文字？

phrases.english: Do we need compliance approval before sending the beta email?
phrases.chinese: 发送公测邮件前，是否需要合规部门审批？

phrases.english: Can we use the new logo in the demo video, or wait for brand?
phrases.chinese: 演示视频中能否直接使用新Logo，还是需等品牌部确认？

phrases.english: Design review ran long — launch moves to next Tuesday.
phrases.chinese: 设计评审耗时较长——上线推迟至下周二。

phrases.english: Content migration hit a snag — go-live shifts to Monday.
phrases.chinese: 内容迁移遇到问题——上线顺延至周一。

phrases.english: Stakeholder feedback came late — final version due Wednesday.
phrases.chinese: 相关方反馈提交较晚——终版周三提交。

phrases.english: I asked finance for the Q3 forecast — they’ll add it by 11 a.m.
phrases.chinese: 我已向财务索要第三季度预测——他们上午十一点前录入。

phrases.english: I asked backend for the API spec — they’ll share it after standup.
phrases.chinese: 我已向后端索要API规范——他们站会后即刻分享。

phrases.english: I asked legal to confirm the SLA — they’ll reply before noon.
phrases.chinese: 我已请法务确认服务等级协议——他们中午前回复。

phrases.english: All critical bugs are fixed — QA cleared staging.
phrases.chinese: 所有关键缺陷均已修复——质检已批准预发布。

phrases.english: Performance tests passed — mobile load time stays under two seconds.
phrases.chinese: 性能测试通过——移动端加载时间始终低于两秒。

phrases.english: Accessibility checks passed — full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
phrases.chinese: 无障碍检测通过——完全符合WCAG 2.1 AA标准。

phrases.english: Support tickets dropped 18% last week — resolution time improved too.
phrases.chinese: 上周客服工单量下降18%——解决时长也有所缩短。

phrases.english: Checkout conversion rose to 62% — up 5 points from baseline.
phrases.chinese: 结账转化率达62%——较基线提升5个百分点。

phrases.english: NPS jumped to +41 — highest in six months, thanks to faster replies.
phrases.chinese: 净推荐值升至+41——六个月来最高，得益于更快的回复速度。

phrases.english: Let’s meet tomorrow at 10 a.m. to review the rollout checklist.
phrases.chinese: 我们明天上午十点碰面，复核上线检查清单。

phrases.english: Can we meet Friday at 9:30 a.m. to go over the comms timeline?
phrases.chinese: 我们周五上午九点半碰面，过一遍传播时间表，可以吗？

phrases.english: How about a 15-minute call Monday at 11 a.m. to confirm next steps?
phrases.chinese: 周一上午十一点安排十五分钟电话，确认下一步行动，如何？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: What does ‘on-call rotation’ mean here?
phrases.chinese: ‘待命轮值’在这里具体指什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: When you say ‘feature flagging’, do you mean turning features on/off for users, or just for internal testing?
phrases.chinese: 你说‘功能开关’，是指面向用户动态开启或关闭功能，还是仅用于内部测试？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Does ‘cross-functional team’ include marketing and sales, or just engineering and product?
phrases.chinese: ‘跨职能团队’包括市场和销售，还是只含工程与产品？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: What’s an example of a ‘lightweight PR review’?
phrases.chinese: ‘轻量级代码评审’具体是什么样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: If we need ‘automated smoke tests’, what’s one thing they must check before every deploy?
phrases.chinese: 要实现‘自动化冒烟测试’，每次部署前必须检查的一件事是什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: What counts as a ‘customer-facing change’ — UI copy update, or backend API behavior shift?
phrases.chinese: ‘面向客户的变更’算什么——界面文案调整，还是后端API行为变化？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Who sees the daily incident summary — engineering leads only, or also customer support managers?
phrases.chinese: 每日事故简报谁能看到——仅工程主管，还是客服经理也要同步？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Should the sprint goal update go to the whole team, or just to the product owner and scrum master?
phrases.chinese: 冲刺目标更新是发给全体成员，还是只发给产品负责人和敏捷教练？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Is the security checklist for developers only, or for QA and DevOps too?
phrases.chinese: 安全检查清单仅供开发人员使用，还是QA和运维也要执行？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Who signs off on vendor contract renewals — legal only, or legal plus finance?
phrases.chinese: 供应商合同续签由谁批准——法务部单独批，还是法务加财务共同批？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: For design handoff, does UX approve final assets only, or also interaction specs and states?
phrases.chinese: 设计交付时，UX只确认最终视觉资源，还是交互说明和状态逻辑也得他们签字？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Do minor copy changes need brand team approval, or only major campaign launches?
phrases.chinese: 小段文案修改需要品牌团队审批，还是只在大型营销活动上线时才需审批？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Should bug reports include screenshots, or just step-by-step text?
phrases.chinese: 缺陷报告要附截图，还是只需分步文字描述？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Do meeting notes go into Confluence as bullet points, or as full transcripts with decisions called out?
phrases.chinese: 会议纪要放进Confluence，是列要点，还是整理成带明确决策项的完整记录？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Should the release checklist be a shared doc, or a printed sign-off sheet?
phrases.chinese: 发布检查清单用共享文档，还是打印签字页？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: You said ‘GDPR-compliant storage’ — was that from the client contract or our internal policy?
phrases.chinese: 你提到‘符合GDPR的存储方式’，是客户合同里写的，还是我们内部政策要求的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: When you mentioned ‘SOC 2 alignment’, did that come from the audit prep doc or last quarter’s roadmap?
phrases.chinese: 你提的‘符合SOC 2标准’，是来自审计准备文档，还是上季度路线图？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: You asked for ‘real-time alerts’ — is that in the monitoring spec or the stakeholder interview notes?
phrases.chinese: 你要求的‘实时告警’，是在监控规范里，还是利益相关方访谈纪要里？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: What makes a feature ‘launch-ready’ — all tests passing, or also user acceptance sign-off?
phrases.chinese: 功能怎样才算‘可上线’——所有测试通过，还是也得用户验收签字？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: For the dashboard, does ‘live data’ mean updated hourly, or refreshed on page load?
phrases.chinese: 仪表盘说的‘实时数据’，是指每小时更新一次，还是页面加载时即时刷新？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: When you say the API is ‘stable’, do you mean no breaking changes, or no new endpoints either?
phrases.chinese: 你说API‘稳定’，是指不改已有接口，还是连新增接口也不允许？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Are weekly syncs every Monday morning, or only when blockers come up?
phrases.chinese: 周同步会是每周一上午固定开，还是只在遇到阻塞问题时才临时召集？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Is the architecture review monthly, or scheduled only before major infrastructure changes?
phrases.chinese: 架构评审是每月一次，还是只在重大基础设施变更前才安排？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Do deployment approvals happen per environment, or once for all staging and prod?
phrases.chinese: 部署审批是每个环境单独批，还是对预发布和生产环境统一批一次？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Who owns the incident comms template — marketing, product, or customer success?
phrases.chinese: 事故对外沟通模板由谁负责——市场部、产品部，还是客户成功团队？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Should the accessibility audit report go to engineering and design, or also to legal and compliance?
phrases.chinese: 无障碍审计报告发给工程和设计，还是法务与合规部门也要看？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Is the onboarding feedback survey for new hires only, or also for their first-line managers?
phrases.chinese: 新人入职反馈问卷只给新员工填，还是他们的直属主管也要填？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Can you share the official remote work policy document?
phrases.chinese: 能发一下正式的远程办公政策文件吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Is there a written guide for handling urgent production bugs?
phrases.chinese: 处理紧急线上缺陷有没有书面操作指南？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in asking for clarification
phrases.english: Do weekend deployments follow the same change advisory board process as weekday ones?
phrases.chinese: 周末上线是否和工作日一样走变更顾问委员会流程？

phrases.english: Could you check the revised slides for clarity and flow?
phrases.chinese: 能帮忙看看修订后的幻灯片，逻辑清不清楚、读起来顺不顺？

phrases.english: Can you skim the updated onboarding email for consistent tone?
phrases.chinese: 能快速扫一眼更新后的入职邮件，看语气是不是前后一致？

phrases.english: Could you glance at the new help page for confusing terms?
phrases.chinese: 方便瞄一眼新版帮助页面，有没有让人看不懂的词？

phrases.english: What’s the single biggest thing that would improve this draft?
phrases.chinese: 这份草稿最需要改哪一点，才能明显变好？

phrases.english: What’s the first thing you’d change in this survey layout?
phrases.chinese: 你看到这个问卷版式，第一反应想改哪里？

phrases.english: If you had to cut one section from this report, which would it be?
phrases.chinese: 如果必须删掉报告里一个部分，你会删哪个？

phrases.english: I’ve made all your suggested changes—ready for your approval?
phrases.chinese: 你提的所有修改我都做了，现在可以请你批准了吗？

phrases.english: Updated the contract as discussed—should I send it to Legal now?
phrases.chinese: 已按我们讨论的意见改完合同，现在发给法务部审核可以吗？

phrases.english: Revised the project plan after our chat—do you want to approve it before sharing?
phrases.chinese: 根据我们刚才的沟通改了项目计划，你希望先批准再发给团队吗？

phrases.english: I’ve updated everything based on your feedback—anything else to tweak?
phrases.chinese: 我已按你的反馈全部改好了，还有别的地方要微调吗？

phrases.english: Rearranged the slides to match your story flow—does it feel smoother now?
phrases.chinese: 按你建议的故事线调了幻灯片顺序，现在读起来更顺畅了吗？

phrases.english: Added your KPIs to the metrics section—do these numbers show what matters most?
phrases.chinese: 指标部分已加入你指定的关键绩效指标，这些数字能反映出最关键的信息吗？

phrases.english: Would moving the meeting to Friday give you time to finalize the agenda?
phrases.chinese: 把会议调到周五，能让你有时间定好议程吗？

phrases.english: If we shift design handoff to Tuesday, does that fit your dev timeline?
phrases.chinese: 如果设计交付挪到周二，和你们开发进度能对上吗？

phrases.english: Can we lock budget categories by Thursday so Finance can run forecasts Friday?
phrases.chinese: 预算分类周四前确认好，财务周五就能做预测，这样行吗？

phrases.english: I missed highlighting local legal requirements in the rollout plan.
phrases.chinese: 我在实施计划里漏掉了对当地法律要求的强调。

phrases.english: The draft leaves out last month’s privacy policy updates.
phrases.chinese: 初稿没包含上个月发布的隐私政策更新。

phrases.english: This version omits the team handoffs we agreed on at kickoff.
phrases.chinese: 这一版漏掉了启动会上明确的各团队交接环节。

phrases.english: Your rewrite of the intro paragraph makes the main point stand out.
phrases.chinese: 你重写的开头段落，让核心观点一下就突显出来了。

phrases.english: Grouping the dashboard charts this way makes priorities instantly clear.
phrases.chinese: 你把仪表盘图表这样分组，重点优先级一眼就看清楚了。

phrases.english: Starting with real customer quotes makes the findings feel much more credible.
phrases.chinese: 用真实客户原话开头，让调研结果显得可信多了。

phrases.english: When do you expect to have feedback ready?
phrases.chinese: 你预计什么时候能给出反馈？

phrases.english: When will the tech review be complete?
phrases.chinese: 技术评审预计什么时候完成？

phrases.english: Do you know when you’ll have notes on the launch calendar?
phrases.chinese: 上线日历的反馈，你知道大概什么时候能给吗？

phrases.english: Thanks for catching those—I’ll send a corrected version by tomorrow.
phrases.chinese: 感谢指出这些问题，我明天就发你修正版。

phrases.english: Thanks for the detailed notes—I’ll send the updated process map by noon.
phrases.chinese: 感谢详细批注，中午前我把修订后的流程图发你。

phrases.english: Good call—I’ll redo the timeline and follow up with you tomorrow.
phrases.chinese: 说得对，我马上重做时间线部分，明天再跟你同步。

phrases.english: We stayed fully aligned—from goals to final edits—every step.
phrases.chinese: 从目标设定到最终修改，每一步我们都完全步调一致。

phrases.english: You set the goals and I delivered—I never went off track.
phrases.chinese: 你定目标，我来执行，全程都没跑偏。

phrases.english: You handled the big picture and I managed the details—we kept everything synced.
phrases.chinese: 你把握大方向，我落实细节，所有环节都保持同步。

phrases.english: Want to figure out the client onboarding issue together now?
phrases.chinese: 现在一起弄清楚客户入驻的问题怎么样？

phrases.english: Got time to go over the vendor contract terms together before signing?
phrases.chinese: 签约前有时间一起过一遍供应商合同条款吗？

phrases.english: Can we lock the sprint review agenda together this afternoon?
phrases.chinese: 今天下午能一起敲定迭代评审议程吗？

phrases.english: Let’s co-write the client onboarding doc — I’ll draft the first part.
phrases.chinese: 我们一起写客户入驻文档吧——我来起草第一部分。

phrases.english: Should we co-author the internal comms plan? I’ll handle the rollout schedule.
phrases.chinese: 内部沟通方案一起起草吧？我来负责落地时间表。

phrases.english: Let’s co-develop the accessibility report — I’ll compile the findings.
phrases.chinese: 无障碍审查报告我们一起做——我来汇总发现项。

phrases.english: I’ve put the slides in the team folder — feel free to edit them live.
phrases.chinese: 幻灯片已放到团队文件夹里——欢迎直接在线编辑。

phrases.english: Client notes are in the shared doc — add your thoughts whenever you can.
phrases.chinese: 客户会议纪要已同步到共享文档，随时补充你的想法。

phrases.english: QA report is open for live edits — go ahead and annotate it.
phrases.chinese: QA报告已开放实时编辑——请直接批注。

phrases.english: I’ll manage the client email thread — you draft the proposal while I do that.
phrases.chinese: 客户邮件往来我来跟进，提案你同步起草。

phrases.english: I’ll coordinate with the venue — you handle catering logistics at the same time.
phrases.chinese: 场地对接我来协调，餐饮执行你同步跟进。

phrases.english: I’ll build the slide deck — you shape the Q&A flow as we go.
phrases.chinese: PPT框架我来搭建，问答环节的逻辑你边推进边梳理。

phrases.english: You’re reviewing the budget draft — what feedback do you have so far?
phrases.chinese: 预算草案由你审阅，目前有什么反馈？

phrases.english: You’re sending the final version to legal — any notes from their review yet?
phrases.chinese: 最终版由你发给法务，他们那边有初步意见了吗？

phrases.english: You’re sharing the timeline with the team — did anyone raise timing concerns?
phrases.chinese: 时间表由你同步给团队，有人提出时间节点方面的顾虑吗？

phrases.english: Let’s split the timeline work — I’ll revise dev phases, you adjust QA milestones.
phrases.chinese: 时间线任务我们拆开做——我来修订开发阶段，你来调整测试节点。

phrases.english: Let’s divide the handoff prep — I’ll finalize design assets, you lock copy specs.
phrases.chinese: 交接准备我们分工——我来定稿设计素材，你确认文案规范。

phrases.english: We should share the API integration load — I’ll debug endpoints, you validate auth flow.
phrases.chinese: API对接工作我们共同承担——我来调试接口，你验证鉴权流程。

phrases.english: Can we co-edit the kickoff agenda live in the shared doc right now?
phrases.chinese: 现在能一起在共享文档里实时编辑启动会议程吗？

phrases.english: Shall we jointly update the client brief in the live doc after the call?
phrases.chinese: 客户电话结束后，我们一起在实时文档里更新需求简报？

phrases.english: Let’s co-markup the roadmap draft in the workspace during our sync.
phrases.chinese: 同步会上我们一起在协作区批注路线图初稿。

phrases.english: Your call on the launch date shift — how does mid-month fit your workload?
phrases.chinese: 上线日期延后由你定——月中这个时间点和你当前工作量匹配吗？

phrases.english: Your suggestion on training timing makes sense — shall we confirm it with stakeholders?
phrases.chinese: 你提出的培训时间很合理——需要我们和相关方正式确认吗？

phrases.english: Thanks for spotting the comms gap — want to co-draft the updated stakeholder message?
phrases.chinese: 感谢发现沟通材料的遗漏——要不要一起起草更新后的相关方通知？

phrases.english: Let’s screen-share and walk through the workflow diagram step by step.
phrases.chinese: 我们共享屏幕，一步步过一遍工作流图。

phrases.english: Can we co-navigate the user journey map live and tag pain points?
phrases.chinese: 我们开个实时会，一起浏览用户旅程图并标记痛点？

phrases.english: Let’s jointly annotate the FAQ doc in a focused 20-minute review.
phrases.chinese: 我们专注花20分钟，一起对FAQ文档做联合批注。

phrases.english: Before we lock the final version — who signs off on each section?
phrases.chinese: 最终版定稿前——每个章节的签字确认人分别是谁？

phrases.english: Before sending to Legal — which sections need their explicit approval?
phrases.chinese: 发给法务前——哪些章节必须获得他们的明确批准？

phrases.english: Before launching — whose green light confirms readiness across teams?
phrases.chinese: 上线前——跨团队就绪状态需哪些人的正式放行？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: The deadline’s fixed, but the new requests need five extra days.
phrases.chinese: 截止日期没法改，但新需求得多花五天。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: The printer jammed all morning — no reports were printed before noon.
phrases.chinese: 打印机一上午都卡纸，中午前一份报告都没打出来。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: The main Wi-Fi network dropped at 3 p.m. — everyone lost internet for forty minutes.
phrases.chinese: 主Wi-Fi网络下午三点断了，所有人断网四十分钟。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Going with the in-house team takes longer but keeps everything under one roof.
phrases.chinese: 用内部团队耗时更长，但所有事都在一个体系里管。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Using auto-scheduling saves effort but sometimes misses urgent tasks.
phrases.chinese: 用自动排期省力，但偶尔会漏掉紧急任务。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Switching to video calls cuts travel time but makes note-taking harder.
phrases.chinese: 改用视频会议省了差旅时间，但记笔记更费劲。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: What if the server goes down during the data transfer?
phrases.chinese: 数据传输过程中服务器宕机了怎么办？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: What if the vendor misses the delivery window by more than a week?
phrases.chinese: 如果供应商交货晚了一周以上，会怎样？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: What happens if we launch without final legal sign-off?
phrases.chinese: 没拿到法务最终签字就上线，会出什么问题？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Let’s wait until the test results come back before moving forward.
phrases.chinese: 等测试结果出来再推进下一步。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: We’ll keep using the current approval checklist instead of writing a new one.
phrases.chinese: 咱们继续用现有的审批清单，不另写新的。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Let’s run the update after business hours when fewer people are logged in.
phrases.chinese: 咱们选下班后人少的时候执行更新。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Do we alert HR if someone’s access stays active after they leave the company?
phrases.chinese: 员工离职后权限还一直开着，要不要通知HR？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Should we pause the chatbot rollout if error rates go above eight percent?
phrases.chinese: 如果聊天机器人错误率超过百分之八，是否该暂停上线？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: When do we bring in customer support if response times cross ten minutes?
phrases.chinese: 响应时间超过十分钟，我们该什么时候请客服团队介入？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: How did ops handle the power outage that shut down the whole floor last month?
phrases.chinese: 上个月整层楼停电，运维是怎么应对的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: What did customer service do when refund requests spiked over the weekend?
phrases.chinese: 周末退款申请暴增，客服是怎么处理的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: How did engineering fix the login loop that hit new users last Tuesday?
phrases.chinese: 上周二新用户遇到的登录死循环，工程部是怎么修复的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Let’s try this on three teams first and check feedback next Friday.
phrases.chinese: 咱们先让三支团队试用，下周五看反馈。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Can we test the new form with two departments before rolling it out everywhere?
phrases.chinese: 新表单能不能先在两个部门试用，再全面铺开？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Let’s pilot the updated schedule with the morning shift only this week.
phrases.chinese: 这周先让早班组试用更新后的排班表。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: What does legal recommend for sharing client data with third parties?
phrases.chinese: 法务对向第三方共享客户数据有什么建议？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: What’s procurement’s take on switching to a single software vendor?
phrases.chinese: 采购部对统一用一家软件供应商怎么看？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: What does QA need from product before signing off on the release?
phrases.chinese: QA在给发布签字前，需要产品提供哪些材料？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Who signs off on budget changes — the director or the finance controller?
phrases.chinese: 预算调整由总监还是财务主管签字确认？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Is the final call on hiring decisions made by the team lead or the talent team?
phrases.chinese: 招聘的最终决定权在团队主管还是人才团队？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: Does the project manager or the client approve scope changes?
phrases.chinese: 项目范围变更由项目经理还是客户批准？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: So we’re freezing scope, keeping the launch date, and doing full QA — right?
phrases.chinese: 那我们冻结功能范围、维持上线日期、做完整质量检测——对吧？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: We’re skipping the optional add-on and adding it in v2 — agreed?
phrases.chinese: 本次跳过可选插件，v2版本再补上——没问题吧？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in problems and decisions
phrases.english: All changes go live Wednesday, not Monday — confirmed?
phrases.chinese: 所有改动周三上线，不是周一——确认无误？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can you send a quote for everything in the proposal?
phrases.chinese: 能就提案里的全部内容发一份报价吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can you quote just the cloud hosting, without support?
phrases.chinese: 能只就云托管服务（不含支持）单独报价吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can you include VAT and confirm it’s valid until December 15?
phrases.chinese: 报价能含增值税，并确认有效期至12月15日吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can you give a three-year quote with fixed prices each year?
phrases.chinese: 能给一份三年期报价，并保证每年价格不变吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Do you give discounts for orders of fifty or more per year?
phrases.chinese: 年订五十台及以上，有折扣吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: If we order all twelve models this quarter, is there a discount?
phrases.chinese: 如果本季度一次性订齐全部十二个型号，有折扣吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: What’s the price per unit if we order two hundred at once?
phrases.chinese: 一次订两百台，单价是多少？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Do universities get the best volume discount?
phrases.chinese: 高校能享受最高档批量折扣吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: What are your usual payment terms for new customers?
phrases.chinese: 新客户通常的付款条件是什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: For EU government contracts, do you accept net 60 terms?
phrases.chinese: 欧盟政府采购合同，你们接受60天账期吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can we pay by credit card for orders under five thousand dollars?
phrases.chinese: 五千元以下的订单，能用信用卡付吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can we pay invoices in euros at the rate on the invoice date?
phrases.chinese: 我们能按发票开具当日汇率，用欧元支付发票吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can you break down the monthly fee into parts?
phrases.chinese: 能把每月费用拆成几部分列出来吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can you split the setup fee between onboarding, training, and config?
phrases.chinese: 能将启动费拆分为上线、培训和系统配置三部分吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: For the enterprise plan, can you separate core access from add-ons?
phrases.chinese: 企业版方案里，能把核心访问权限和可选附加功能分开列吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can you show what portion of the maintenance fee covers updates and support?
phrases.chinese: 维保费里，更新和响应支持各占多少比例？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: How long is this price good for?
phrases.chinese: 这个价格有效期是多久？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Is the $1,890 rate locked in until June 30?
phrases.chinese: 每月1890美元这个价格，能锁定到6月30日吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Does the promo price end June 30, or apply to orders shipped by then?
phrases.chinese: 促销价是6月30日截止，还是只要那天前发货就适用？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: When does the current price become fixed for multi-year deals?
phrases.chinese: 多签约几年，当前价格何时正式固定不可更改？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Is this price in US dollars and does it include all taxes?
phrases.chinese: 这个价格是美元计价吗？是否已含所有税费？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Does the $3,600 delivery price include California sales tax and import duties?
phrases.chinese: 3600美元的到货价，是否已含加州销售税和进口关税？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Is the €2,450 price before German VAT, and will you issue a VAT invoice?
phrases.chinese: 2450欧元这个价格是否未含德国增值税？你们会开增值税专用发票吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Does the ¥8,200 quote cover full delivery to Shanghai, including customs and local delivery?
phrases.chinese: 8200元的报价，是否已含货物抵达上海的全部费用，包括清关和本地配送？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: What’s the smallest order for custom hardware units?
phrases.chinese: 定制硬件机型的最小起订量是多少？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Is there a minimum spend to get the enterprise SLA?
phrases.chinese: 要享受企业级服务等级协议，有最低采购金额要求吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Do we need at least five hundred licenses to unlock premium analytics?
phrases.chinese: 启用高级分析功能，至少需要五百个许可吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: What’s the lowest quantity you’ll print for custom packaging?
phrases.chinese: 定制包装，你们接受的最少印刷数量是多少？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: How soon do you ship after we approve the order?
phrases.chinese: 我们确认订单后，你们多久发货？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: How fast do you ship standard units from Rotterdam?
phrases.chinese: 从鹿特丹仓发标准机型，要多久？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can we get next-day delivery if we order and pay by credit card before 2 p.m. CET?
phrases.chinese: 欧洲中部时间下午2点前下单并用信用卡付款，能次日达吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Do you ship directly to our factory in Ho Chi Minh City, and how long does it take?
phrases.chinese: 你们能直发我们胡志明市工厂吗？一般要几天？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: What does your standard warranty cover, and how long is it?
phrases.chinese: 标准保修都保什么？保多久？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Does the three-year warranty cover accidental damage?
phrases.chinese: 三年保修包含意外损坏吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Is on-site repair included in the basic warranty?
phrases.chinese: 基础保修包含上门维修吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Can we add extended warranty after the first year?
phrases.chinese: 首年之后还能加购延保服务吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Do you give a discount for paying the full invoice within ten days?
phrases.chinese: 发票全款十天内付清，有折扣吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Is there a 2% discount for paying the full amount within five banking days?
phrases.chinese: 五个银行工作日内结清全款，能享2%折扣吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Do you offer any incentive for paying invoices before the 25th?
phrases.chinese: 每月25日前结清发票，有提前付款激励吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in pricing and terms
phrases.english: Do you charge late fees if payment arrives after thirty days?
phrases.chinese: 付款超过三十天到账，会收滞纳金吗？

phrases.english: We’re quoting $95 an hour — does that fit your budget?
phrases.chinese: 我们报价每小时95美元——符合您的预算吗？

phrases.english: We’ll deliver the full report in ten days — does that match your review cycle?
phrases.chinese: 我们十天内交付完整报告——和您内部审阅周期一致吗？

phrases.english: We include onboarding and setup — does that cover your team’s first-week needs?
phrases.chinese: 我们含上线支持和系统配置——能满足您团队首周使用需求吗？

phrases.english: We can meet your timeline if you approve the draft by Friday — is that possible?
phrases.chinese: 如果您周五前批准初稿，我们就能赶上您的时间表——这可行吗？

phrases.english: We can start next Monday if you confirm the list of users by Thursday — works for you?
phrases.chinese: 如果您周四前确认用户名单，我们下周一就能启动——您这边方便吗？

phrases.english: We can ship by Wednesday if you waive the final sign-off — okay with that?
phrases.chinese: 如果您免去最终签字确认环节，我们周三就能发货——可以接受吗？

phrases.english: You said delivery is guaranteed by June 15 — does that require all feedback by May 25?
phrases.chinese: 您说6月15日前确保交付——这是否以5月25日前收齐全部反馈为前提？

phrases.english: You confirmed free revisions are included — does that mean up to three rounds, or unlimited?
phrases.chinese: 您确认免费修改已包含在内——是指最多三轮，还是不限次数？

phrases.english: You mentioned same-day response — does that apply only on weekdays?
phrases.chinese: 您提到当天响应——这仅适用于工作日吗？

phrases.english: If you handle content upload, can we move launch to June 20?
phrases.chinese: 如果贵方负责内容上传，我们能把上线时间提前到6月20日吗？

phrases.english: If you provide access to your CRM by Tuesday, can we begin integration Wednesday?
phrases.chinese: 如果贵方周二前开放CRM系统权限，我们周三就能开始对接吗？

phrases.english: If you share brand guidelines today, can we send mockups tomorrow?
phrases.chinese: 如果贵方今天提供品牌规范，我们明天就能发设计样稿吗？

phrases.english: We can’t start before July 10 — our team is fully booked until then.
phrases.chinese: 我们无法7月10日前启动——团队此前已全部排满。

phrases.english: We can’t offer discounts — our pricing is fixed across all clients.
phrases.chinese: 我们无法提供折扣——对所有客户执行统一价。

phrases.english: We can’t add extra features — the scope is locked after this week.
phrases.chinese: 我们无法增加额外功能——范围本周后即锁定。

phrases.english: Let me check with my manager and get back to you by 3 p.m. — okay?
phrases.chinese: 我跟主管确认一下，下午3点前给您答复——可以吗？

phrases.english: Let me talk it over with operations and reply by end of day — works?
phrases.chinese: 我跟运营同事商量一下，今天下班前回复您——来得及吗？

phrases.english: Let me verify with procurement and confirm by 11 a.m. — good timing?
phrases.chinese: 我跟采购同事核实一下，上午11点前确认——时间合适吗？

phrases.english: Instead of lowering the fee, can we extend support to six months?
phrases.chinese: 与其降低费用，不如把支持期延长到六个月，如何？

phrases.english: Rather than reducing hours, can we add weekly check-ins and a shared dashboard?
phrases.chinese: 与其减少服务时长，不如增加每周例会和共用数据看板，可以吗？

phrases.english: Instead of cutting scope, can we include post-launch analytics and a handover session?
phrases.chinese: 与其缩减范围，不如加入上线后数据分析和交接会议，怎么样？

phrases.english: So: contract signed Monday, deposit paid Tuesday, work starts Wednesday — right?
phrases.chinese: 所以：合同周一签署，预付款周二支付，周三启动工作——对吧？

phrases.english: To confirm: design approved Friday, dev begins Monday, QA starts Wednesday — yes?
phrases.chinese: 再确认：设计周五获批，开发下周一启动，测试周三开始——是这样吗？

phrases.english: Just checking: go-live June 15, training scheduled for June 20, final invoice sent June 25 — correct?
phrases.chinese: 再核对一下：6月15日上线，培训安排在6月20日，终版发票6月25日发出——没错吧？

phrases.english: Let’s agree on Phase One now — just the core system — and finalize custom parts later.
phrases.chinese: 我们先敲定第一阶段——仅核心系统——定制部分后续再定。

phrases.english: Can we roll out the standard version to all offices this month, then add local language support next quarter?
phrases.chinese: 我们能否本月向所有办公室推出标准版，下季度再加配本地语言支持？

phrases.english: Let’s pilot with two departments first, then scale company-wide once we’ve tested it.
phrases.chinese: 我们先选两个部门试点，等验证通过后再全公司推广。

phrases.english: I’ll send a short email summary of today’s agreement by 5 p.m. — please flag anything missing by 9 a.m. tomorrow.
phrases.chinese: 我下午5点前发送今日协议要点的简短邮件——如有遗漏，请明早9点前指出。

phrases.english: I’ll update the shared notes with what we settled today — can you skim and reply ‘looks good’ or suggest edits by 10 a.m.?
phrases.chinese: 我会更新共享笔记，写入今日达成的共识——请您快速浏览，明早10点前回复“没问题”或提出修改意见。

phrases.english: I’ll send the revised timeline tonight — just hit reply and say ‘approved’ or list changes by 11 a.m. tomorrow.
phrases.chinese: 我今晚发送修订后的时间表——请明早11点前直接回复“已批准”或列出需调整项。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Here's the proposal — let me know if anything needs adjusting.
phrases.chinese: 提案在这儿——有任何需要调整的地方，随时告诉我。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: We aligned the timeline with your launch window — full proposal is attached.
phrases.chinese: 时间表已按您的上线窗口对齐，完整提案已附上。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: We kept the scope tight to match your Q3 capacity — proposal ready now.
phrases.chinese: 范围已收紧以匹配您第三季度的承载能力，提案现已就绪。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: When’s a good time to hear your thoughts on the proposal?
phrases.chinese: 您什么时候方便说说对提案的看法？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: When’s a good time for legal to flag any contract concerns?
phrases.chinese: 法务部什么时候方便指出合同条款方面的问题？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: When’s a good time for finance to confirm the payment terms work?
phrases.chinese: 财务部什么时候方便确认付款条款是否可行？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Just confirming: you’ll give final approval before we send it out?
phrases.chinese: 再确认一下：发出去前由您最终批准，对吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Just confirming: you’ll sign off on the SLA wording before we finalize?
phrases.chinese: 再确认一下：服务等级协议措辞定稿前由您签字确认，对吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Just confirming: you’ll review the vendor list before we submit to procurement?
phrases.chinese: 再确认一下：提交采购部门前由您审阅供应商清单，对吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: What’s your internal timeline for making a decision?
phrases.chinese: 贵方内部决策的时间安排是怎样的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: What’s the committee’s timeline for selecting finalists?
phrases.chinese: 评审委员会确定入围名单的时间安排是怎样的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: What’s leadership’s timeline for signing off before budget freeze?
phrases.chinese: 管理层在预算冻结前完成审批的时间安排是怎样的？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Would adding a phased rollout help fit your schedule better?
phrases.chinese: 改成分阶段上线，是否更符合您的时间安排？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Would deferring the reporting module ease your team’s bandwidth right now?
phrases.chinese: 把报表模块延后实施，是否能缓解您团队当前的工作压力？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Would bundling support into the first year simplify your approval process?
phrases.chinese: 把支持服务打包进第一年费用，是否能让您的审批流程更简单？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Per our call, only core features are included — no add-ons in this version.
phrases.chinese: 按我们通话约定，本版仅含核心功能，不包含任何附加项。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Per our call, only English documentation is included — no translations planned.
phrases.chinese: 按我们通话约定，本版仅提供英文文档，不安排翻译。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Per our call, user training is excluded — only admin setup is covered.
phrases.chinese: 按我们通话约定，用户培训不在范围内，仅覆盖管理员配置。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Want a quick 20-minute call to walk through the key points?
phrases.chinese: 需要我们花20分钟电话过一遍关键点吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Want a 15-minute call to clarify how the pricing tiers apply?
phrases.chinese: 需要我们花15分钟电话说明各档报价的具体适用方式吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Want a 10-minute call to explain how the milestones tie to your goals?
phrases.chinese: 需要我们花10分钟电话说明各里程碑如何对应您的目标吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: To move forward: are scope, timing, and cost all clear?
phrases.chinese: 为推进下一步：范围、时间和成本这三项都明确了，对吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: To move forward: are data ownership, access rights, and audit terms all clear?
phrases.chinese: 为推进下一步：数据所有权、访问权限和审计条款这三项都明确了，对吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: To move forward: are handover steps, documentation standards, and exit support all clear?
phrases.chinese: 为推进下一步：交接步骤、文档标准和退出支持这三项都明确了，对吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Following up on our talk yesterday — happy to reply by email or jump on a call.
phrases.chinese: 跟进昨天的沟通——邮件回复或电话沟通，我随时配合。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Following up on the scope discussion — happy to revise the deliverables list now.
phrases.chinese: 跟进范围讨论——我现在就可以修改交付物清单。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Following up on the timeline feedback — happy to shift the go-live date if needed.
phrases.chinese: 跟进时间线反馈——如有需要，我很乐意调整上线日期。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Once approved, shall we set the start date and assign the project lead?
phrases.chinese: 获批后，我们来确定启动日期并指派项目经理，可以吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Once approved, shall we lock in the first delivery date and notify the team?
phrases.chinese: 获批后，我们来敲定首次交付日期并通知相关团队，可以吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in proposals and follow up
phrases.english: Once approved, shall we share the onboarding plan and schedule the first sync?
phrases.chinese: 获批后，我们来共享上线准备计划并安排首次同步会议，可以吗？
