phrases.english: I'm really sorry that happened — I'll fix it right away.
phrases.chinese: 真抱歉发生了这事，我马上帮您解决。

phrases.english: I'm really sorry your package arrived damaged — we’ll send a replacement tomorrow.
phrases.chinese: 很抱歉您的包裹送达时已破损，我们明天就寄出替换件。

phrases.english: That’s not okay — I’m taking care of this myself and will update you by 5 p.m.
phrases.chinese: 这确实不对——我亲自处理，今天下午5点前向您同步进展。

phrases.english: What part isn’t working, and when did it start?
phrases.chinese: 具体哪个部分不正常？是从什么时候开始的？

phrases.english: Which screen froze when you tried to reset your password?
phrases.chinese: 您重设密码时，是哪个界面卡住了？

phrases.english: When exactly did the receipt print blank instead of the total?
phrases.chinese: 小票空白没显示金额，是哪次打印出现的？

phrases.english: You’ll see the credit in your account within two business days.
phrases.chinese: 款项将在两个工作日内到账。

phrases.english: The corrected order confirmation will be in your inbox by 10 a.m. tomorrow.
phrases.chinese: 修正后的订单确认邮件明天上午10点前发送到您邮箱。

phrases.english: Our team will call you with an answer before 4 p.m. today.
phrases.chinese: 我们的团队今天下午4点前会电话给您明确答复。

phrases.english: We’re sending you a $25 credit as a thank-you for your patience.
phrases.chinese: 为感谢您的耐心，我们为您发放25美元账户余额。

phrases.english: We’ve waived the restocking fee on your return.
phrases.chinese: 您的退货免收返货手续费。

phrases.english: We’re upgrading your next shipment to express delivery at no extra cost.
phrases.chinese: 您下次发货将免费升级为加急配送。

phrases.english: The system skipped your address because the field was left blank.
phrases.chinese: 系统跳过了您的地址，因为该栏位留空未填。

phrases.english: Your refund didn’t go through because the bank rejected the transfer.
phrases.chinese: 您的退款未成功，是因为银行拒绝了这笔转账。

phrases.english: The discount didn’t apply because the item wasn’t in the eligible category.
phrases.chinese: 折扣未生效，是因为该商品不在活动适用范围内。

phrases.english: I’ll get our lead agent on this right now.
phrases.chinese: 我现在就请主管专员来处理这件事。

phrases.english: Let me bring in our service supervisor — they can approve exceptions.
phrases.chinese: 我马上请服务主管介入，他有权批准特殊处理。

phrases.english: I’m transferring you to our escalation team — they’ll take over right away.
phrases.chinese: 我正将您转接至升级处理组，他们将立即接手。

phrases.english: How should I follow up — email, phone, or text?
phrases.chinese: 我该用哪种方式跟您联系——邮件、电话，还是短信？

phrases.english: Should I text you when the repair is booked, or call after the technician arrives?
phrases.chinese: 维修预约成功后我发短信通知您，还是等师傅到场后再电话告知？

phrases.english: Would you like a quick email summary now, or wait for the full update later?
phrases.chinese: 您希望现在先收到一封简要邮件摘要，还是稍后等完整进展再同步？

phrases.english: Does this work for you?
phrases.chinese: 这样处理可以吗？

phrases.english: Is the new pickup time okay, or would Monday morning suit you better?
phrases.chinese: 新的取件时间可以吗？还是周一上午更合适？

phrases.english: Before we close this, does the updated plan match what you asked for?
phrases.chinese: 在结案前，请问更新后的方案是否符合您的要求？

phrases.english: We now require double-checking before any cancellation goes through.
phrases.chinese: 现在所有取消操作都必须经过二次确认才生效。

phrases.english: All support tickets now auto-flag if the same issue is reported more than once.
phrases.chinese: 所有客服工单现在都会自动标记：同一问题重复上报即触发预警。

phrases.english: Our chat system now saves conversation history so agents don’t ask the same questions twice.
phrases.chinese: 我们的聊天系统现已保存对话历史，避免专员重复提问。

phrases.english: Just to check: you want to keep the current service but stop automatic renewal, correct?
phrases.chinese: 再确认一下：您想保留当前服务，只关闭自动续订，对吗？

phrases.english: So you’d like to change the billing contact from your old email to the one you just gave me?
phrases.chinese: 所以您想把账单联系人邮箱，从原来的换成刚才您提供的这个，对吗？

phrases.english: To confirm: you contacted us about the late delivery, not the missing item?
phrases.chinese: 再确认：您联系我们是反映送货延迟，而不是物品缺失，对吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: What kind of product are you looking for?
phrases.chinese: 您想找哪类产品？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: Which item are you planning to reorder next?
phrases.chinese: 您下一批打算补哪款货？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: Is there a category you’d like us to start with this time?
phrases.chinese: 这次您希望我们先从哪类产品开始推荐？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: What type of product are you launching for your new store?
phrases.chinese: 您新店开业主推哪类产品？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We supply kitchenware, home textiles, and small electronics.
phrases.chinese: 我们供应厨房用品、家用纺织品和小家电。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We stock ready-to-ship pet supplies and office accessories for Amazon sellers.
phrases.chinese: 我们为亚马逊卖家备有现货的宠物用品和办公配件。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We make OEM and private-label apparel and bags.
phrases.chinese: 我们做服装和包袋类的OEM和贴牌生产。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: Our fastest-shipping items right now are LED desk lamps and silicone kitchen tools.
phrases.chinese: 目前发货最快的是LED台灯和硅胶厨具。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We source directly from factories across China and handle the whole process for you.
phrases.chinese: 我们直接从中国各地工厂采购，并为您全程跟进。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We’ll pick the right factory, check compliance, and oversee production — all from our Shenzhen office.
phrases.chinese: 我们深圳团队负责选厂、验厂和生产全程跟进。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We manage three certified suppliers in Ningbo, Guangzhou, and Yiwu — same QC, one contact.
phrases.chinese: 我们对接宁波、广州、义乌三家认证供应商，质检标准统一，您只对接我们一人。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: You tell us the category — we match vetted factories, negotiate MOQ, and ship samples to LA or Hamburg in 10 days.
phrases.chinese: 您说品类，我们匹配已验厂工厂、谈最小起订量，并在10天内把样品发到洛杉矶或汉堡。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: Here’s our latest catalog — specs, lead times, and real factory photos inside.
phrases.chinese: 这是我们的最新产品目录，含参数、交期和工厂实拍图。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: I just sent the spec sheet for stainless steel water bottles — includes material certs and test reports.
phrases.chinese: 刚发了不锈钢水杯的规格书，含材质证书和检测报告。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: Attached is the BOM and assembly guide for the smart plug — ready for your engineers.
phrases.chinese: 附件是智能插座的物料清单和组装指南，方便您工程师直接评估。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We updated the catalog with your color options — PDF and Excel versions are in the email.
phrases.chinese: 已按您要求更新目录，新增配色方案，PDF和Excel版都在邮件里了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We handle everything — from raw materials to final packaging.
phrases.chinese: 从原材料到最终包装，所有环节都由我们负责。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We work with three certified factories — two for assembly, one for precision parts.
phrases.chinese: 我们合作三家认证工厂：两家组装，一家专做精密零部件。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: For local component sourcing, we use trusted partners in Guangdong and Zhejiang.
phrases.chinese: 本地配件采购，我们用广东和浙江的长期合作供应商。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: For anodizing or silk-screening, we use two nearby specialist workshops.
phrases.chinese: 阳极氧化或丝印这类工艺，我们固定用两家本地专业作坊。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We can take 5,000 units/month of this model without affecting other orders.
phrases.chinese: 这款我们每月能稳接5000台，不影响其他订单交期。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We keep 20% capacity open year-round for urgent new orders like yours.
phrases.chinese: 我们全年预留20%产能，专门应对您这类紧急新单。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: With our new third line, orders over 3,000 units ship in 25 days.
phrases.chinese: 启用第三条产线后，3000台以上订单25天出货。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: For your repeat order, we’ll use the same line and team — no setup delay.
phrases.chinese: 您这批返单，我们用原产线、原班组，无需重新调试。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We’ve shipped similar items to the US, UK, and Australia for over eight years.
phrases.chinese: 类似产品我们已向美国、英国和澳大利亚出口八年多了。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We’ve handled EU customs clearance and labeling since 2019.
phrases.chinese: 从2019年起，我们就帮欧盟客户处理清关和标签。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We’ve managed end-to-end logistics for Canadian retailers for five years.
phrases.chinese: 我们为加拿大零售商做全链路物流服务已有五年。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We’ve supported Latin American startups with drop-shipping since 2021.
phrases.chinese: 从2021年起，我们就帮拉美初创公司做代发服务。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We do OEM and private label — you provide design or brand, we build it.
phrases.chinese: 我们做OEM和贴牌——您提供设计或品牌，我们负责生产。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We’ll adapt packaging and manuals to German requirements for your launch.
phrases.chinese: 您在德国上线新品，我们按当地要求调整包装和说明书。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We’ll apply labels, barcodes, and carton markings here for your Amazon FBA launch.
phrases.chinese: 您做亚马逊FBA首发，我们在这边直接贴标、打条码、印箱唛。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: We add logos, colors, and safety certs to existing models for US brands.
phrases.chinese: 我们帮美国品牌在现有型号上加Logo、配色和安全认证。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: This one sells well in Germany — happy to send samples if it fits your market.
phrases.chinese: 这款在德国卖得特别好，如果适合你们市场，我们可以马上寄样。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: It’s popular in Mexico — worth testing alongside your current products?
phrases.chinese: 这款在墨西哥很畅销，要不要和你们现有产品一起试一试？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: US retailers ask for this style often — good for your back-to-school launch?
phrases.chinese: 美国零售商常问这款，很适合你们的返校季上新吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: It’s our top e-commerce seller in Australia — lightweight and easy to brand.
phrases.chinese: 这是我们在澳洲电商渠道最畅销的款——轻便、还方便贴牌。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: To give you an accurate quote, what’s your target price, order size, and key specs?
phrases.chinese: 为了给您报准价，方便提供下目标价、预计订量和关键规格吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: Before finalizing packaging, what’s your ideal MOQ and unit budget?
phrases.chinese: 包装定稿前，您理想的起订量和单件预算是多少？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: For custom colors — what volume and unit price range work for you?
phrases.chinese: 定制颜色这块，您预期订多少量？单件能接受的价格区间是多少？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in introducing products and capability
phrases.english: To schedule production, can you confirm your PO size and landed cost goal?
phrases.chinese: 为了安排生产，方便确认下您预计的采购单数量和到岸成本目标吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: What size, color, and quantity do you need—and where will they be used?
phrases.chinese: 您需要什么尺寸、颜色和数量？这些产品用在什么地方？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: For your EU launch, what voltage, plug type, and yearly volume do you need?
phrases.chinese: 您在欧盟上市，需要的电压、插头类型和年采购量分别是多少？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: For your Amazon FBA restock, what’s the weight per unit and units per carton?
phrases.chinese: 这次补货发往亚马逊FBA，单个产品毛重多少？每箱装几件？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Where should we ship—and which Incoterm works best for you: FOB, EXW, or DDP?
phrases.chinese: 货要发到哪里？FOB、EXW还是DDP，哪种贸易术语对您最方便？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: For your new Mexico warehouse, should we quote landed cost including duties and local delivery?
phrases.chinese: 您在墨西哥的新仓，需要我们报含关税和本地派送的到岸价吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: For your Berlin pop-up next month, can you confirm the address and preferred Incoterm?
phrases.chinese: 您下个月在柏林的快闪店，能确认收货地址和希望采用的贸易术语吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Our best price is $8.50/unit for 5,000 pcs, ex-works Shenzhen.
phrases.chinese: 这是我们最优报价：5000件，深圳工厂交货，单价8.5美元。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: For your repeat order of 3,000 units, we’re keeping last quarter’s price—$7.20 FOB Ningbo.
phrases.chinese: 这批3000件复购订单，我们按上季度价格执行——宁波港FOB单价7.2美元。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Since you’re switching to eco-packaging, the new price is $9.10/unit FOB—valid if ordered by Friday.
phrases.chinese: 因您改用环保包装，新报价为FOB单价9.1美元，本周五前下单有效。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: MOQ is 500 units per style—we’re open to lower for your first order.
phrases.chinese: 每款起订量是500件，首单我们可以商量少一点。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: That MOQ is for standard colors—custom colors start at 1,000 units.
phrases.chinese: 这个起订量适用于常规颜色，定制颜色要1000件起。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: OEM packaging requires 3,000 units MOQ—but we’ll hold stock for repeat orders.
phrases.chinese: 贴牌包装的话，起订量是3000件，不过复购我们可以提前备货。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: More units mean a lower price—e.g., $8.50 at 1k, $7.20 at 5k.
phrases.chinese: 量越大单价越低——比如1000件是8.5美元，5000件就降到7.2美元。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Same logic applies to accessories: buy 2k cables with your main order, and cable price drops 15%.
phrases.chinese: 配件也一样：主单配2000条线缆，线缆单价直接降15%。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: If we ship all cartons together, freight cost per unit goes down.
phrases.chinese: 如果把这些纸箱合并成一票货发出，平均到每件的运费会更低。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: This quote is valid for 30 days—just let us know before then if you’d like to lock it in.
phrases.chinese: 这份报价30天内有效，到期前你确认下单就行。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: The sample quote is valid 14 days—after that, material costs may change.
phrases.chinese: 打样报价有效期14天，过期后材料成本可能调整。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Your bulk quote expires in 20 days—but we’ll honor it if production starts by then.
phrases.chinese: 大货报价20天后失效，但只要在这之前开工生产，我们就按原价执行。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: We ask for 30% deposit before production—the balance is due against B/L copy.
phrases.chinese: 我们通常在生产前收30%定金，余款见提单副本付清。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: For larger orders, we can adjust the split—say, 50% up front and 50% on shipment.
phrases.chinese: 订单量大的话，我们可以调整付款比例，比如50%预付、50%发货时付。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: For repeat customers, we offer net-30 terms after two smooth shipments.
phrases.chinese: 老客户复购，只要前两批货顺利走完，我们可以改成货到后30天付款。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Sample fee is $85—fully refunded if you place bulk order within 60 days.
phrases.chinese: 打样费85美元，60天内下单就全额退还。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Tooling cost is $1,200—but we cover it for your first three container orders.
phrases.chinese: 开模费1200美元，但您头三柜订单我们全包。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Basic samples are free—you just pay express shipping; custom ones take 3–5 days and cost $60.
phrases.chinese: 普通样品免费，您只付快递费；定制样品要3到5天，收费60美元。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Switching to standard cartons saves $0.35/unit—same protection as gift boxes.
phrases.chinese: 换成标准纸箱，每件省35美分，防护效果和礼盒一样。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Switching from silk-screen to pad printing cuts setup time and lowers MOQ to 500 pcs.
phrases.chinese: 从丝印换成移印，起订量能降到500件，制版时间也减半。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Using recycled kraft paper instead of white board cuts cost and improves sustainability.
phrases.chinese: 用再生牛皮纸代替白卡纸，可以降低成本，也能让包装更环保。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Shall we proceed with the PO—or would you like to make any changes first?
phrases.chinese: 我们接下来走订单流程，还是您想先调整什么？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Are you ready to confirm the sample order—or do you need more time to review specs?
phrases.chinese: 您准备好确认打样订单了吗？还是需要更多时间核对规格？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in inquiries quotes and terms
phrases.english: Can we schedule production—or is there anything still pending on your end?
phrases.chinese: 我们可以安排生产了吗？还是您那边还有未决事项？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We’ll send a free sample—just share your shipping address.
phrases.chinese: 我们免费寄一个样品，把收货地址给我们就行。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Happy to send a sample for your buyer meeting—just tell us where to ship it.
phrases.chinese: 您买家会议要用的样品，我们很乐意寄送，告诉我们要发到哪儿就行。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We’ll ship one sample by express so you get it before your Friday review.
phrases.chinese: 我们用快递发一个样品，确保您周五评审前收到。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Sample is $20, and we ship it in 2 working days.
phrases.chinese: 样品20美元，2个工作日内发出。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: The label proof is $15—it’s ready in 2 days.
phrases.chinese: 标签打样15美元，2天内做好。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Your new packaging layout costs $28, and we’ll email the PDF tomorrow.
phrases.chinese: 您更新的包装版式28美元，明天就发PDF给您。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: So black logo on light gray box—right?
phrases.chinese: 那Logo是黑色，盒子是浅灰色——对吧？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Just confirming: matte lid with embossed logo?
phrases.chinese: 再确认下：盖子哑光面，Logo压印？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Final check: barcode top-left on side panel?
phrases.chinese: 最后确认：条形码放在侧面左上角？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Can you send the logo file or a photo of the reference sample?
phrases.chinese: 能把Logo文件发给我们，或者拍张参考样件的照片发来吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Do you have a photo of the packaging you’d like us to match?
phrases.chinese: 您现有包装有照片可以发给我们参考吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Could you mark where the logo should go on the product?
phrases.chinese: 能标一下Logo该印在产品哪个位置吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We’ll make one prototype first, adjust it with your feedback, then start full production.
phrases.chinese: 我们先做一版原型，按您的反馈调整好，再启动全量生产。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We’ll run 50 test units first, wait for your OK, then do the full order.
phrases.chinese: 我们先试产50件，等您确认后再做整单。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We’ll test the new color on one machine first, check it, then roll out.
phrases.chinese: 新颜色我们先在一台设备上试跑，确认效果后再全线铺开。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Does this sample meet your expectations—can we start bulk production?
phrases.chinese: 这个样品符合您的预期吗？我们可以启动大货生产了吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Is the stitching and fabric weight right for the jacket—shall we approve it?
phrases.chinese: 夹克样品的车线和面料克重都对吗？咱们可以批准了吧？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Does the material’s texture and thickness match what you need—good to lock in?
phrases.chinese: 这块材料的手感和厚度符合您的要求吗？可以定稿了？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Every sample is checked after making and again before it ships.
phrases.chinese: 每个样品做完查一遍，发货前再查一遍。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: All orders get final inspection before packing—no exceptions.
phrases.chinese: 所有订单装箱前都做最终检验，没有例外。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We match color to your physical swatch before releasing any sample.
phrases.chinese: 放行任何样品前，我们都拿您的实物色样比对确认。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: What certifications or test reports does your market require?
phrases.chinese: 您的市场需要哪些认证或检测报告？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: All our electronics include CE and RoHS docs—they’ll ship with your order.
phrases.chinese: 所有电子产品都附CE和RoHS文件，随货一起提供。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: If you need lab test results for safety compliance, we’ll email them today.
phrases.chinese: 如果安全合规需要实验室检测报告，我们今天就发您邮箱。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We’ll remake the sample at our cost and ship it free—no delay.
phrases.chinese: 这个样品我们自费重做，包邮发出，不耽误时间。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Same for your first order—if anything’s off, we’ll fix or refund right away.
phrases.chinese: 您首单也一样，有问题我们立刻补发或退款。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We’ve fixed the issue and shipped the corrected sample—tracking number coming soon.
phrases.chinese: 问题已解决，修正后的样品已发出，单号稍后发您。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Before mass production, please confirm this is the final version we’ll follow.
phrases.chinese: 大货生产前，请确认这是我们要执行的最终版本。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: Can you confirm these dimensions are locked in before we cut the mold?
phrases.chinese: 开模前，您能确认下这些尺寸已定稿吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in samples customization and quality
phrases.english: We won’t print labels until you approve the final artwork.
phrases.chinese: 最终版图稿您没确认前，我们不会印任何标签。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: We’ve received your deposit — can we confirm the final order now?
phrases.chinese: 我们已收到您的定金，现在可以确认最终订单吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Your deposit came through this morning — shall we lock in the shipping method and destination port?
phrases.chinese: 您的定金今早已到账——我们现在确认运输方式和目的港吧？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Deposit is confirmed — just need your go-ahead on the carton dimensions and pallet configuration.
phrases.chinese: 定金已确认——只需您批准纸箱尺寸和托盘堆叠方式。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Production starts after sample approval and takes 25 days.
phrases.chinese: 样品确认后开始生产，周期为25天。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Once you approve the fabric swatch, we’ll be ready to ship in 18 days.
phrases.chinese: 您一确认面料样卡，我们18天后就能出货。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: With all artwork signed off, production will finish in 22 days — no delays expected.
phrases.chinese: 所有图案稿已签字确认，生产22天完工——不会延误。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: We begin production Monday — I’ll send a start-up photo and schedule summary.
phrases.chinese: 我们周一启动生产——我会发一张开工实拍图和排期简表。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Line starts tomorrow — first inspection report goes out Friday morning.
phrases.chinese: 产线明天开工——首份验货报告周五上午发出。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Cutting begins Tuesday — I’ll share the cut ticket and batch numbers by noon.
phrases.chinese: 裁剪周二开始——我中午前同步裁床单和批次号。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Your goods are being packed now — here’s a live photo from packing station.
phrases.chinese: 您的货物正在装箱——这是包装工位的实时照片。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: All items passed final check — I’ve attached the QC report and timestamped photos.
phrases.chinese: 所有货品已通过终检——QC报告和带时间戳的照片已附上。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Boxes are sealed and stacked — video of full pallet loading is ready for download.
phrases.chinese: 纸箱已封好并码垛完成——整托装柜视频已可下载。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: The main fabric shipment was delayed — it arrives Thursday, and we restart same day.
phrases.chinese: 主面料运输延迟了——周四到厂，当天就恢复生产。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Our label printer broke down yesterday — new parts arrive Wednesday, and we resume printing then.
phrases.chinese: 我们的标签打印机昨天坏了——新配件周三到，到货即恢复打印。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: One component failed safety testing — replacement units ship Monday and reach us Tuesday.
phrases.chinese: 某个部件安全测试未通过——替换件周一发货，周二到厂。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: We can ship 60% next week and the rest in 5 days — does that fit your needs?
phrases.chinese: 我们可以下周先发60%，余下5天内发完——这符合您的需求吗？

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: If color A isn’t ready, we’ll ship colors B and C first — same price, no delay to your warehouse.
phrases.chinese: 如果A色还没备好，我们先发B色和C色——价格不变，也不耽误您入仓。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: We’ll use air freight for the full order — delivery in 4 working days, at our cost.
phrases.chinese: 整单改走空运——4个工作日送达，运费由我们承担。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Pre-shipment inspection is set for next Wednesday — let me know if you’d like to join online.
phrases.chinese: 出货前验货已定在下周三——如需线上参与，请告诉我。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Inspector is scheduled for Thursday — we’ll provide real-time video feed during the check.
phrases.chinese: 验货员已约周四——验货全程提供实时视频画面。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: You’re welcome to send your own inspector — just tell us the date, and we’ll prepare everything.
phrases.chinese: 欢迎您派自己的验货员来——只要告知日期，我们提前备好一切。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Carton labels, shipping marks, and packing list match your PO exactly.
phrases.chinese: 纸箱标签、运输标识和装箱单与您的采购单完全一致。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: All outer boxes show your logo and ‘Fragile’ stickers — photo proof sent.
phrases.chinese: 所有外箱均印有您的Logo和“易碎”标识——照片已发送。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Packing list includes unit weight and total CBM — let me know if you need customs declaration fields added.
phrases.chinese: 装箱单已含单件毛重和总体积——如需补充报关字段，请随时告诉我。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Shipment left the factory this morning — tracking is live and export docs are filed.
phrases.chinese: 货物今早已离厂——物流单号已生效，出口文件已申报。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: We ship FOB Shanghai — you book the vessel and handle import clearance.
phrases.chinese: 我们按上海港离岸价（FOB）出货——您订舱并负责进口清关。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Freight costs went up slightly — I’ll update the invoice and send revised sailing details today.
phrases.chinese: 运费略有上调——我今天更新发票并发送修订后的开船信息。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Your order shipped this morning — tracking is active, and I’ll check in next Monday.
phrases.chinese: 您的订单今早已发出——物流单号已生效，我下周一再跟进。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Full container shipped 3 hours ago — BL copy and ETA will follow within 24 hours.
phrases.chinese: 整柜3小时前已发出——提单副本和预计到达时间24小时内发送。

phrases.intent: communicate naturally in orders production and shipping
phrases.english: Small parcel with samples went out this morning — tracking link and photo of packed box sent.
phrases.chinese: 寄样品的小包今早已发出——物流链接和打包实拍图已发送。
